Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.$B$BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.$B$BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
8920.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bracers of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8920.title: An Earnest Proposition

8922.description: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!$B$BI know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural.  He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!$B$BThe blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
8922.objectivesText: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
8922.title: A Supernatural Device

8923.description: You must be quite brave to have stuck around after that.  That or I've piqued your interest with the piece of armor I gave you.  There is more from where that came from, if you're still interested in aiding me.$B$BThe venom samples you collected are for an acquaintance of mine, Mux Manascrambler, an engineer with an interest in the supernatural.  His latest project consists of a device that allows you to communicate with the dead!  My last hope is to contact Anthion and find out more about my situation.
8923.objectivesText: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8923.title: A Supernatural Device

8928.description: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting.$B$BI met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods.  He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly.  I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it.$B$BHe lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge.  Sneak in there and try to find him.$B$BMake sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
8928.objectivesText: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8928.title: A Shifty Merchant

8931.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me an ordinary belt and a set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.
8931.objectivesText: Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
8931.title: Just Compensation

8937.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
8937.objectivesText: Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Deliana in Ironforge.
8937.title: Just Compensation

8938.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
8938.objectivesText: Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8938.title: Just Compensation

8942.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gauntlets.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
8942.objectivesText: Bring a Cord of the Elements and a set of Gauntlets of the Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8942.title: Just Compensation

8944.description: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $n.  As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.$B$BFor now I will exchange your belt and gauntlets.  If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
8944.objectivesText: Bring a Belt of Valor and a set of Gauntlets of Valor to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8944.title: Just Compensation

8945.description: I'll provide you the information you ask for, $n.  But more pressing matters are at hand.$B$BMy beloved wife has been taken prisoner by Rivendare's undead scum.$B$BI strongly objected to her joining the Argent Dawn's foolish crusade, yet that's not of importance anymore.  You must finish what I attempted to do, you must rescue Ysida from the clutches of the Baron!
8945.objectivesText: Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
8945.title: Dead Man's Plea

8948.description: Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight.  I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.$B$BWith some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.$B$BAn old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required.  He has a particular way of... aggravating people.  You shall find him at the library in Dire Maul.
8948.objectivesText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
8948.title: Anthion's Old Friend

8958.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
8958.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Dreadmist Sandals, Dreadmist Leggings and Dreadmist Mantle.
8958.title: Anthion's Parting Words

8959.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
8959.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Boots of Valor, Legplates of Valor and Spaulders of Valor.
8959.title: Anthion's Parting Words

8961.description: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.$B$BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and Executor Asharell in the Steppes, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
8961.objectivesText: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Ash of Asharell, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8961.title: Three Kings of Flame

8966.description: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.$B$BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
8966.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8966.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8968.description: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the Scarlet Crusade upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.$B$BFrom what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the Scarlet Bastion.$B$BIn any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
8968.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8968.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8969.description: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.$B$BKormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.$B$BBut even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
8969.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8969.title: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8970.description: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.$B$BThis is where you come in, $n. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
8970.objectivesText: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8970.title: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...

8977.description: It's been great working with you, $n.  Here is the finished product.$B$BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors.  And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word.  I wouldn't mind having more customers!
8977.objectivesText: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer  to Deliana in Ironforge.
8977.title: Return to Deliana

8985.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BIsalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
8985.objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8985.title: More Components of Importance

8986.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BMor Grayhoof, our most prominent druid, had many close friends amongst the Cenarion Circle, some of which have fallen to the silithid. I need you to retrieve some Druidical Remains from the silithid that inhabit the environs of Hive'Regal in southeastern Silithus.
8986.objectivesText: Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8986.title: More Components of Importance

8987.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades.$B$BThe siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
8987.objectivesText: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8987.title: More Components of Importance

8988.description: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.$B$BAn ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
8988.objectivesText: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
8988.title: More Components of Importance

8989.description: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.$B$BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
8989.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8989.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8990.description: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.$B$BShe didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
8990.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
8990.title: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8995.description: All is now ready, $n.$B$BWhen alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire.$B$BOnce you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.$B$BGood luck!
8995.objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.
8995.title: Mea Culpa, Lord Valthalak

8996.description: I will ignore your impertinence this time, $c, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, $r, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!$B$BReturn to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
8996.objectivesText: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
8996.title: Return to Bodley

8997.description: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.$B$BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
8997.objectivesText: Speak with Deliana at The High Seat in Ironforge.
8997.title: Back to the Beginning

8998.description: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.$B$BGo, before I start to cry. Go back to Mokvar in Orgrimmar and tell him what's happened.
8998.objectivesText: Speak with Mokvar at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
8998.title: Back to the Beginning

9015.description: Heed me well, $n.  For the banner to work in the desired way, you will need to step into the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths.  Allow yourself to be sentenced by High Justice Grimstone and place the banner firmly on the ground in a sign of defiance.$B$BYour victim will not be able to restrain himself and shall enter the fray filled with a desire to fight you.  Once you obtain that which you seek, go back to Anthion.
9015.objectivesText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone.  Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.
9015.title: The Challenge

9016.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
9016.objectivesText: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
9016.title: Anthion's Parting Words

9031.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck, and you shall need it!
9031.title: <TXT>Anthion's Parting Words

9051.description: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.$b$bTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
9051.objectivesText: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
9051.title: Toxic Test

9052.description: I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a $c can hope to collect the ingredients.$b$bYou can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the giant flying wasps inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
9052.objectivesText: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
9052.title: Bloodpetal Poison

9053.description: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$b$bIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$b$bReturn to me when this is done.
9053.objectivesText: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
9053.title: A Better Ingredient

9085.description: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.$b$bIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
9085.objectivesText: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
9085.title: Shadows of Doom

9126.description: Don Julio's Bonescythe armor pattern requires bone fragments - a lot of bone fragments. While those crazy enough to venture into Naxxramas provide me with enough of the core materials to make the armor, I'm always looking for more Scourge bone fragments.$B$BSo what do you think? Interested in getting your hands dirty and destroying some Scourge at the same time? It's a win-win situation.
9126.objectivesText: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.
9126.title: Bonescythe Digs

9136.description: I make a special type of armor for the brave heroes that enter Naxxramas known as Dreamwalker. They are able to provide me with most of the materials I require but I am always looking for those able to retrieve savage fronds from the flora of our world.$B$BYou may think of this job as beneath you, but without the fronds, the armor could not be made.$B$BI am also in a unique position to pay you with an insignia of your choice as both the Dawn and the Crusade supply me with funds.
9136.objectivesText: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.
9136.title: Savage Flora

9141.description: You want a writ? What? Do you expect me to hand you a highly sought after work order just for showing up? I think not, scrub. Crafters from around the world bid for jobs here at the front lines.$B$BIf you want a work order, you'll have to show me that you're willing to bleed for the cause. Bring me a valor token and we'll talk.$B$BAnd there's only one way to get your grubby little scrub mitts on those - get to killin'.
9141.objectivesText: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.
9141.title: They Call Me "The Rooster"

9154.description: The Scourge have returned in greater numbers than we have seen before. The Argent Dawn is recruiting all willing and capable men and women to defend our lands.$b$bIf we share common cause, take this document to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9154.objectivesText: Deliver the Call to Arms Announcement to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9154.title: Light's Hope Chapel

9247.description: $n,$B$BIn times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.$B$B$n, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
9247.objectivesText: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9247.title: The Keeper's Call

9250.description: With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.$B$BFind someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
9250.objectivesText: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
9250.title: Frame of Atiesh

9262.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Darnassus from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9262.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Darnassus and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9262.title: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus

9263.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Orgrimmar from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9263.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9263.title: Investigate the Scourge of Orgrimmar

9264.description: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Thunder Bluff from these accursed invaders? $b $bThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you.  Go!
9264.objectivesText: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles nearby their encampment.
9264.title: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff

9292.description: On the corpse of the fallen abomination, you discover a cracked crystal, slowly pulsing with necrotic energy.
9292.objectivesText: Bring the Cracked Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Orrin outside the gates of Stormwind.
9292.title: Cracked Necrotic Crystal

9300.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9300.objectivesText: Take the Ragged Page to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9300.title: Page from the Front

9302.description: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
9302.objectivesText: Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9302.title: Missive from the Front

9310.description: On the corpse of the fallen wight, you find a crystal that is faintly radiating necrotic energy.
9310.objectivesText: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.
9310.title: Faint Necrotic Crystal

9319.description: We are not the only ones who celebrate this holiday, $n. All creatures, all cultures, are touched by the flame. Even in the darkest places, the fires are being lit.$b$bIf you wish to see them for yourself, travel into the depths. Seek out the bonfires burning within Stratholme, Scholomance, among the ogres of Dire Maul, and the halls of Blackrock Spire itself; I will await your return.
9319.objectivesText: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire Maul, Scholomance, and Stratholme, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9319.title: A Light in Dark Places

9322.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is celebrated everywhere in Azeroth, and the diverse land of Kalimdor is no exception. You look fit to travel -- perhaps a journey is in order.$b$bMidsummer cannot be truly appreciated unless you've seen the blistering blue fires abroad. The celebrants have lit fires in chilly western Winterspring, northeastern Azshara, near Valor's Rest in the wastes of Silithus, and by the entrance to lush Un'Goro. Return once your journey is complete.
9322.objectivesText: Visit the Midsummer camps located in Azshara, Silithus, Un'Goro Crater, and Winterspring, then return to the Festival Flamekeeper.
9322.title: Wild Fires in Kalimdor

9323.description: Our celebration of the flame is spread throughout the land, $c. Not a single place remains untouched by the heat of this holiday, and the strongest fires burn a brilliant blue. Seek them out.$b$bYou'll find one just north of Blackrock Spire. The others are located deep within the Eastern Plaguelands near a decrepit town, along the road to the cliffs within the mountainous Hinterlands, and on the way to the Dark Portal within the Blasted Lands.$b$b Return once your journey is done.
9323.objectivesText: Visit the Fire Festival camps located in Blasted Lands, Eastern Plaguelands, the Hinterlands and Searing Gorge, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9323.title: Wild Fires in the Eastern Kingdoms

9324.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Orgrimmar itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9324.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Orgrimmar to the Festival Loremaster.
9324.title: Stealing Orgrimmar's Flame

9325.description: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
9325.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
9325.title: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame

9330.description: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9330.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
9330.title: Stealing Stormwind's Flame

9332.description: This flame, stolen from the shores of Teldrassil, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
9332.objectivesText: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
9332.title: Stealing Darnassus's Flame

9362.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor.  Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
9362.objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
9362.title: Warlord Krellian

9368.description: Midsummer is upon us once again!$b$bEach year, as tradition dictates, Flamekeepers are chosen to tend the bonfires within our capitals. While fires are burning throughout Azeroth, it is imperative that ours be the hottest and brightest, to properly pay homage to the season.$b$bIn fact, I have a task for you, if you don't mind. I've not yet heard if the fires in all capitals are properly burning. Travel there yourself and warm yourself by the fires--make sure they're hot!
9368.objectivesText: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.
9368.title: The Festival of Fire

9389.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival traditionally lights up the land with a myriad of flames. Some argue that the green fires are the finest, as they are the hardest to maintain and have such a distinctive hue.$b$bMake sure they still burn in the Eastern Kingdoms for our Flamekeeper. They sit near Dun Modr in the Wetlands, close to Pyrewood Village within Silverpine Forest, on the cliffs overlooking the lighthouse in Westfall, and by the ruined tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
9389.objectivesText: Visit the bonfires within Hillsbrad Foothills, Silverpine Forest, Westfall, and the Wetlands, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
9389.title: Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms

9415.description: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.$b$bWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?$b$bNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
9415.objectivesText: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
9415.title: Report to Marshal Bluewall

9422.description: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.$b$bBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.$b$bI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
9422.objectivesText: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
9422.title: Scouring the Desert

9664.description: Welcome to the Plaguelands, $n. As you know, the Forsaken and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The Alliance commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.$b$bTowers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
9664.objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.
9664.title: Establishing New Outposts

9665.description: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.$b$bIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
9665.objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
9665.title: Bolstering Our Defenses

65593.description: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure.$b$bMy scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally.$b$bIn Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet.$b$bThey toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593.objectivesText: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.
65593.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65602.description:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602.objectivesText: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
65602.title: What Is Love?

65603.description:
The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center.

Then the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world.

A sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it.

If you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.
65603.objectivesText: Using the Wooden Figurine, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Wooden Figurine to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Slaughtered Lamb.
65603.title: The Binding

65604.description:
Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $n. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a warlock's final mistake.

When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604.objectivesText: Using the Withered Scarf, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Withered Scarf to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65604.title: The Binding

78092.description:
The tendrils of sentience reaching out from this orb are too much for even an experienced warlock like myself to withstand for long. I am reluctant to admit this, $n, but the orb must be destroyed.

The orb is nearly impervious, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I have heard that such a blade is present in Ashenvale--at the site where the pit lord Mannoroth was destroyed.

Gather motes of the fallen demon's essence there, then shatter the orb upon the blade.
78092.objectivesText: Gather 12 Motes of Mannoroth from demons in Ashenvale. Bring them along with the Orb of Althalaxx to the Spear of Mannoroth at Demon Fall Canyon.
78092.title: It Must Be Destroyed

78093.description: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
78093.objectivesText: Return the Orb Shards to Delgren.
78093.title: Return to Delgren

78823.description: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78823.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

78830.description:
This drawing reminds me of a story I'd heard on another expedition, not long ago. I was told of a great bird, Gharrik, who reigns over the Badlands as an apex predator.

She was last spotted northeast of Camp Cagg. Perhaps her nest is somewhere nearby?

You'll need live bait to draw her out. I'll lend you a cage to catch some. Small wildlife is scarce in the Badlands, so you'll need to find your bait elsewhere.

A quill from Gharrik would make a fine prize. You'd certainly be the talk of the camp.
78830.objectivesText: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
78830.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79008.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.title: ... and that note you found

79090.description: Some of the Warsong Outriders lie defeated, but the battle still rages...
79090.objectivesText: Bring the Warsong Outrider Mark to Felore Moonray, Priestess of the Moon, at the Moonwell base in Ashenvale.
79090.title: Repelling Invaders

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

79242.description:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
79242.objectivesText: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.title: No Honor Among Thieves

79365.description: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365.objectivesText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.
79365.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79366.completionText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Freewind Post and report what happened.
79366.description:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $n. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
79366.title: Heed My Call

79482.description: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79482.objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79482.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79483.description: Listen... not to shatter the magic of the season here, but Smokywood Pastures could use some assistance - the kind you adventuring types are known to give.$B$BWe're missing an important shipment of treats that was restocking us for the season, and now we're missing the agent of Smokywood Pastures that we sent out to the field to find it!  Please - the shipment was last reported in the Alterac Mountains, and that's where our man went to look for it.$B$BSee if both are out there, safe and sound!
79483.objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.
79483.title: Stolen Winter Veil Treats

79495.description: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!

objectives.text: Find Metzen the Reindeer and rescue him

79495.objectivesText: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.
79495.title: Metzen the Reindeer

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79677.description:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.
79677.objectivesText: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
79677.title: A Quick Grocery Run

79678.description:
Ok $r buddy, it time for Skonk favorite part. Skonk have fire hot and ready, and want to share new dish with new friend. You do such big favors for Skonk; it only right you get some too!

Let Skonk know when you ready for tasting.
79678.objectivesText: Taste test the recipe with Skonk.
79678.title: Taste Testing

79731.description:
<The ancient glyphs resolve into words before your eyes.>

When Zul'Kunda's fountain runs with the waters of the holy spring, the gods grant their blessing.
79731.objectivesText: Solve the riddle of the scroll. Once you've done that, Hemet Nesingwary might like to hear the tale.
79731.title: The Troll Scroll

79940.description:
<Katherine winces as she holds the shattered fragments of the broken hammer> 

I won't speak of this weapon's master in detail for the telling would fill me with shame, but I'll tell you what I can.

objectives.text: Speak with Katherine and Learn More

79940.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure and learn more about the broken hammer.
79940.title: A Lost Brother

79946.description: Due to the... unfortunate nature of why he left the order, it would be bad comedy for Aeonas to die at the hands of the Scarlet Crusade now. The Crusade is an organization of zealots and lunatics and they've been growing increasingly brazen in their willingness to commit violence against anyone who they imagine to be enemies of the light. Go to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and find out if Aeonas still lives.

objectives.text: Learn more about Aeonas from Katherine
Find Aeonas in the Scarlet Monastery

79946.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine to learn more about Aeonas, and then find him in the Scarlet Monastery.
79946.title: A Brother In Need

79949.title: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends

79951.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79963.description: <Aeonas needs immediate healing or he will die. Call upon the light and save him.>
79963.title: By The Light's Grace

79970.description:
Thank you for saving me, $c. It seems that I'm not as young as I once was, and I think I'm going to need allies for what is to come. Please, meet me in Stormwind in the Cathedral of Light as soon as you are able.

Don't worry about me, I can find my way out of here on my own. I just need a few moments to recover my strength

objectives.text: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind

79970.objectivesText: Meet Aeonas at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
79970.title: Aeonas the Vindicated

80241.description: When I was about your age, a dwarf by the name of Galvan took me under his wing and trained me in the ways of the armorsmith. Before he left for Booty Bay, he made me promise to train all those with the desire and determination to advance in the craft of blacksmithing -- so here I am -- all these years later.$B$BSo, now it's time for you to learn a little something. Make me six golden scale bracers and you will learn where smithing comes from, $n.
80241.objectivesText: Bring six Golden Scale Bracers to Hank the Hammer in Stormwind.
80241.title: The Origins of Smithing

80411.description:
From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak. 

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.  

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
80411.objectivesText: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.
80411.title: The Talisman of Kazdor

80453.description:
Take the talisman down to Zan Shivsprocket, in the basement. I've asked him to rig the artifact with a mechanism that will detect any attempt to channel magic energy into, or out of, it.

The mechanism is all but invisible to the naked eye, and will detonate when triggered. With any luck, Caius will be killed in the blast. At the very least, his plans for the talisman will be foiled.
80453.objectivesText: Bring the Talisman of Kazdor to Zan Shivsprocket in the basement of Ravenholdt Manor.
80453.title: Best Laid Plans

80454.description:
The bait is ready, now we must lay the trap. I've modified the talisman per Fahrad's instructions. All that's left is for you to deliver it as you have the other artifacts before.

Go to the cabin near Pyrewood Village, and put this modified talisman into Caius' dead drop.

What follows is out of our hands, for now.
80454.objectivesText: Take the Modified Talisman to Caius' dead drop near Pyrewood Village.
80454.title: One Last Drop

80455.description: The job is done. Better return to Ravenholdt and notify Fahrad.
80455.objectivesText: Report back to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor.
80455.title: Biding Our Time

81762.description: Greetings, $n. I have good news. I've made contact with my friend, and I am leaving soon to meet with him. What's more, another orb has surfaced in Kalimdor.  I cannot be in two places at once so if you are willing, I'd like for you to go in my stead to follow up on this new orb. Speak with Katherine for further instructions.
81762.objectivesText: Speak with Katherine the Pure at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
81762.title: Some Good News

81764.description:
Well met again, $n. Shaw and his spies have provided us with information on a mysterious merchant who just arrived in Kalimdor and is looking to offload a collection of dangerous artifacts. We've come to believe that he has an Echoing Orb in his collection. He is staying at the Theramore Inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Travel quickly, retrieve the orb, and speak to no one of this. We are sending you in alone to avoid drawing the attention of our enemies. 

Be safe, and go with the light.

objectives.text: Travel to Theramore and find the mysterious merchant.

81764.objectivesText: Travel to Theramore and find the mysterious merchant.
81764.title: The Mysterious Merchant

81766.description:
<You find a missive on the body of the "paladin". It is covered in blood and difficult to read, but you can make out the message on the parchment.

It's clear upon reading the note that this entire venture to find the "merchant" was a trap. You should return to Katherine for further instructions.>

81900.description:
<The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". 

Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims.

You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>
81900.objectivesText: Find an expert on the beasts of the Blasted Lands.
81900.title: The Burning Beast

82062.description:
Had to be sure we could trust you. These kind of friends are hard to come by. 

There's a malignancy growing, a sinister faction within Azeroth. Both the Horde and Alliance are unwittingly working towards their own ends. Slowing their advances and forming information networks are all we have resources for.

Take this, raise your spirits, and harken back to better days. There will be a time soon where we need our bolstered numbers for a show of force.
82062.title: Ever After

82068.description: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands today and you'll earn an extra reward.

objectives.text: Complete a Nightmare Incursion Mission in Hinterlands or Feralas

82068.objectivesText: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands and then report to Field Captain Korlian or Field Captain Arunnel.
82068.title: Fight the Nightmare Incursions

82084.description:
Your progress in the arcane arts has been exemplary, $n. I think you are ready to author a spellbook of your own.

Let's see... a quill from the Owlbeasts of the Hinterlands, and ink derived from silithid resin... yes, that will do. And for the pages, the finest Farraki Papyrus!
82084.objectivesText: Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.
82084.title: A Lesson in Literacy

82135.description: <Aeonas says nothing, he merely hands you the orb and turns away>

objectives.text: Bring the Mannoroc Echoing Orb to Katherine

82135.objectivesText: Bring the Mannoroc Echoing Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
82135.title: The Price of Hope

83934.description: Heya! You look like the "resourceful adventurer" type so maybe you can help me out. See, my brothers and I came from Kezan looking to start up a new business venture but we ran afoul of some pirates who stole our startup money. The people who are funding our operation back home aren't exactly what I'd call understanding, so we'd make it worth your while if are able to find any of the coin and return it. It's no ordinary gold but you should know it when you see it.
83934.objectivesText: Bring a Tarnished Undermine Real to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
83934.title: Show Me the Money!

84124.description: The spectral champion yields and motions toward the altar.
84124.objectivesText: Return to the Altar of Reverence
84124.title: Legacy of Valor

84135.description: Lying on the shore, half-lost in the afternoon spray, is a strange metal contraption. It looks like some kind of mech, but you have never seen anything like it before. You notice a label on its side that reads "Property of D.E.L.T.A.: Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance". You also spot a small compartment that you might be able to open.
84135.objectivesText: Use a rock or something to dislodge parts of the mech.
84135.title: Beach Bot

84137.description: You wonder why this mech was crashed here, and what this liquid is for. Maybe you can use it to reach the nearby islands and oil rig that seem to be connected to this mysterious organization. Opening the vial, a mildly intoxicating fruity aroma greets your nose.
84137.objectivesText: Find a use for the Guided Buoyancy Accelerant
84137.title: Mechanical Romance

84147.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
84147.objectivesText: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
84147.title: An Earnest Proposition

84165.objectivesText: Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
84165.title: Just Compensation

84166.description: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.

84180.description: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
84180.objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
84180.title: Anthion's Parting Words

84195.objectivesText: Give Deliana your Wildheart Cowl and Wildheart Vest.
84195.title: Saving the Best for Last

84318.description:
Oi! $c! Yes, ye! Ye did me a solid by smashing up that depressin' mess of a meatsuit I've been riding in all these years, but I dinnae feel much of a pull to move on. I'm expectin' it's because I got some "Unfinished Business" to get up to 'afore I can be on me way. Well dull-wit, ye just been conscripted to help!

I need ye to fetch me hammer. Should be somewhere in Corrin's Crossing and it'll be hard to miss. 

Oi, take this too. It's me favorite gold tooth. Give it a rub when you've found me weapon.
84318.objectivesText: Find Orthas' missing hammer in Corrin's Crossing.
84318.title: Oi!

84319.description:
Great job with the hammer, $c. Next up is me armor. Definitely need that back to move on to the great beyond.

Only problem is it's in the eh... innards o' one of them abominations. I know, I know, it's askin' a lot, but ye gotta understand I was once a mighty thane under the mountain! I simply can't move on knowin' that the ancestral armor of me clan is dissolving in the gutjuice of a giant rotting mountain o' meat!
84319.objectivesText: Orthas needs you to recover his missing armor from the corpse of an Abomination somewhere in Plaguewood.
84319.title: Oh No Ye Don't!

84332.description:
<You hear a disembodied voice in your head as you touch the small chest> 

Can't be thankin' ye enough, $n. Not how ye'd be expecting it to turn out, no doubt! Just so you aren't too sour about it, I've got something for ye that I've no more use for that I think ye might find useful.

Good luck to ye, $n. Ah, one last thing... if ye happen to see a giant floating necropolis in the distance someday soon, I'd be turnin' tail and runnin' if I were ye. Hah!
84332.title: A Thane's Gratitude

84414.description:
<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?

objectives.text: Send Orthas' Spirit On His Way

84414.objectivesText: Observe Orthas as he moves on from this world.
84414.title: Send Me On Me Way

84550.description: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
84550.objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.
84550.title: Codex of Defense

85712.description: Satisfaction. It is what I draw from the hammer and the anvil. To see a proud Horde warrior protected under my steel reminds me of what it is to be alive. It is an addiction that I dare never give up, $n.$B$BI can not grant you this satisfaction, merely set you upon the path. As with all of life's endeavors, the path of the armorsmith is a journey.$B$BIf you wish to be one of the select few, you need only to ask and I shall train, but, a task you must first complete.
85712.objectivesText: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.
85712.title: The Art of the Armorsmith

86577.description:
The corruption that rains down from Hyjal flows through the mountain's waters and seeps into everything here in the wood. The creatures that drink the water take the corruption into themselves. It makes them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

To counter these effects, I must understand them, and to do that I need samples from the afflicted.

A few samples of putrescent organs from the wolves and bears should do. Take your time; the creatures are common here in Felwood.
86577.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Putrescent Bear Organs and $2oa Putrescent Wolf Organs to Kelek Skykeeper.
86577.title: A Sampling of Putrescence

86585.description:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.objectivesText: Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.
86585.title: Banner of the Fallen

86613.description: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.objectivesText: Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
86613.title: Excavation Tools

86614.description: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.objectivesText: Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
86614.title: Silver of the Waves

86752.description:
There is much more to be done in our fight against the satyr, $n.

If you wish be of further help, speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at the camps of Ursolan to the north. He will know where to use your abilities best. You should find Ursolan to the north of here.
86752.objectivesText: Speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
86752.title: Report to Rageroar

86757.description:
Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
86757.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
86757.title: Slowing the Orc Advance

86758.description:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.objectivesText: Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.
86758.title: Twisting the Knife

86791.description:
Not long ago I sent a party of scouts to gather information on the Legashi stronghold and possibly find our chieftain. They have yet to return. I am beginning to fear the worst.

The Legashi have many camps to the east of here. If any members of the party are still alive they are likely somewhere nearby.
86791.objectivesText: Find the Blackmaw scouting party near the Legashi camps east of Ursolan.
86791.title: Missing Blackmaw Scouts

86797.description:
With the Legashi stronghold weakened, we can return to Ursolan in honor.

Go ahead of me, and inform Gatekeeper Rageroar of the situation here.
86797.objectivesText: Return to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.
86797.title: Return to Rageroar

86798.description:
With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, $n.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.
86798.objectivesText: Speak to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold and ask him to provide reinforcements.
86798.title: Timbermaw Reinforcements

86799.description:
<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, $r, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.
86799.objectivesText: Speak to Elder Bramblesnap about Furze's illness.
86799.title: Encroaching Corruption

86804.description:
Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
86804.objectivesText: Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.
86804.title: An Unlikely Source

86812.description:
I have transmuted the firewater into a tincture which I believe will be the key to undoing the Legashi's corruption. Eager as I am to ease the suffering of the Blackmaw, it must be tested.

I have seen many of the coursers and skystormers east of Ursolan suffering from the satyr's corruption. They will serve as our test subjects.

Go, and test my would-be cure on the afflicted beasts. Before giving the tincture the beast must be weakened to ensure it can be administered with little resistance.
86812.objectivesText: Use the Satyrweed Tincture on $1oa Mosshoof Coursers or Thunderhead Skystormers after weakening them.
86812.title: Transmuted Tincture

86813.description:
I must say, $c. I have not felt this optimistic in some time. This tincture could be the panacea that saves us from the satyr's ever-expanding blight. Even if we remain in these camps for the rest of our lives we will stand strong and free of corruption.

Go to Furze and give him this panacea. He has suffered for long enough. Return to me to report any findings.
86813.title: Potential Panacea

86927.description:
As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.
86927.objectivesText: Bring the Legashi Firewater to Elder Bramblesnap at Ursolan.
86927.title: Running Firewater

87288.description:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.
87288.title: Soft Saber Pelts

87491.areaDescription: Escort the fire elemental out of Dun Modr
87491.description:
Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!
87491.objectivesText: Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.
87491.title: Spark of Freedom

87492.description:
You may have seen some of the unusual crystal growths that dot this crater. I'm not a miner, but these growths don't seem to fit with the kinds of soil deposits all around here.

I believe I caught sight of a damaged crystal not far from here while I was foraging. I wonder if it holds any secrets about the origins of these strange formations? If you happen to spot it, I would love to investigate a sample piece.
87492.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Damaged Blue Crystal back to Torwa Pathfinder.
87492.title: Uncanny Crystal

87494.description:
This scale is slightly more reflective and iridescent than the others, as if it's embedded with tiny particles of crystal.

Torwa Pathfinder might be able to make something of this.
87494.objectivesText: Take the Crystal Infused Scale to Torwa Pathfinder.
87494.title: Microcrystal Contamination

87760.description:
I have received word back from Darnassus, $n!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.objectivesText: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
87760.title: Holy Diver

88812.description:
I fear time may soon forget the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest. A lone, crumbling, monument is the only surviving proof of their presence here.

The monument can be found atop the cliffs at the very tip of the southern peninsula. Spitelash enchantresses there have a set of power stones which they use to channel their magic. Take this ward, and nullify them. This will cripple the Spitelash's magic, and give us an upper hand in driving them out.

While you're at it, be sure to take out a few naga yourself.
88812.objectivesText: Kill 5 Spitelash Battlemasters, 5 Spitelash Enchantresses, and nullify the 3 Naga Power Stones near Ravencrest Monument for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88812.title: Reclaiming Ravencrest

88821.description:
While scouting along the cliffs of the Shattered Strand, one of our sentinels noticed a kaldorei woman on the beach.

Clearly, she is not with our expedition, and she did not have the makings of a fighter. I wonder then, what she could be doing in such a hostile place as this.

If you can, try to make contact with her. I would like to know her purpose for being here, and if our interests are perhaps aligned.

She was last seen on the eastern coast, along the north side of the Bay of Storms.
88821.objectivesText: Find the Kaldorei woman last seen on the Shattered Strand.
88821.title: Making Contact

88884.description:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
88884.objectivesText: Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88884.title: Highborne Tablets

89001.description:
Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
89001.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89001.title: Home on the Range

89015.description:
If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
89015.objectivesText: Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89015.title: Deadliest Catch

89038.description:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
89038.objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89038.title: A Monumental Task

90487.description:
$n, I have little more to offer. If you mean to make the long trek up the mountain, you might do well to speak with some of its ancient caretakers.

Follow the road to the west. Look north, toward the foot of the mountain. You will eventually see an outpost, a remnant of the guardians that once roamed the slopes. There is an ancient there named Fraxinus. He and his friends can assist you.
90487.objectivesText: Travel west from the hermit's cave to find an outpost of ancients and dryads on the lower slopes of Mount Hyjal.
90487.title: Ancient Allies

90750.description:
Battles are often long and hard fought, led by those willing to stand against an imminent threat and look death in the face.

The truth is, many sacrifices were made, not just on the battlefield. We often overlook those who do their part to contribute.

Just yonder is a peasant by the name of... well come to think of it, I don't even know his name. What kind of person am I? He's kept us well-tended and nourished throughout our stay.

Could you speak with him? Let him know the job's done.
90750.objectivesText: Speak with the peasant to let him know the job's done.
90750.title: More Work?

90789.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe beast is known as Scalebeard, hiding in a cave among the Bay of Storms. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell from his den.
90789.objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
90789.title: Scalebeard

90813.description: <The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with knowledge in geology could say what you've really found.>
90813.objectivesText: Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.
90813.title: Pay Dirt!

90865.description:
Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains.

Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult.

Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
90865.title: Eyes of the Watchers

91209.description:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

objectives.text: Report to Shari Stilwell in Brill

91209.objectivesText: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
91209.title: Continue Your Training

91282.description:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.objectivesText: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
91282.title: A Second Home

91285.description:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.
