A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91317.description:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.objectivesText: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.
91317.title: The Tarnished

91488.description:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
91488.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.
91488.title: Home on the Range

91497.description:
<The seal of the first crystal bears the mark of a sword. Its energy must be channeled by an expert warrior.

The seal of the middle crystal bears the mark of a glaive. Its energy must be channeled by one of both martial and magical prowess.

The seal of the last crystal bears the mark of a talon. Its energy must be channeled by one at home in the wilds.

It's likely that some of Rimtori's officers are carrying these seals to aid her in the spell. Taking them would no doubt be troublesome for her.>
91497.objectivesText: Bring the Seal of the Warden, Seal of the Warrior, and Seal of the Ranger to the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.
91497.title: Seals of the Sin'dorei

91531.description: Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself!$B$BAh, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, $n.
91531.objectivesText: Bring the Head of Magus Rimtori to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
91531.title: Revenge Exacted

91538.description:
Rimtori's tome still sits atop its pedestal. Who knows what secrets its pages could hold? 

Perhaps it would be best not to leave such a powerful artifact out here in the wilds.
91538.objectivesText: Bring the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning back to Jediga in Valormok.
91538.title: Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning

91564.description:
We've been stuck here for five years, and we've had to build everything from scratch! Do you know how much I've had to improvise just to do any engineering?

Hey, if you can help me out with some materials, I can make it worth your time! Build me a couple of Mithril Casings and a Mechanical Repair Kit so that I can fix up some stuff, and I'll show you a few things I've figured out.
91564.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Mithril Casings and $2oa Mechanical Repair Kit to Hnaz Blunderflame.
91564.title: Itching for a Fixing

91568.description:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!
91568.objectivesText: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.
91568.title: Long Walks on the Beach

91610.description:
Meat is well and good, but a varied diet makes the body stronger.

Winter squid are in season, and can be fished from the coasts here in Azshara. I never took to angling myself. I much prefer the safety of land. Although, were you to fish some up, or obtain them via some other means, I would greatly appreciate it.
91610.objectivesText: Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Kurll at Valormok.
91610.title: Winter Frontier Fishery

91685.description:
When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff.

I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline.

If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich!

If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.
91685.objectivesText: Use the Mana-Siphoning Wand on the Leyline Rift in Lake Mennar and bring the Tear of Mennar to Izvi Gildfizz.
91685.title: Ley of the Land

91698.description:
<A matriarchal furbolg speaks to you from within the cage>

"Deadwood trap me and my cub in tough cage. Key hang on Deadwood Warden belt. You hunt them, take key, lift latch, set us free. Do this, and Barkskin know your heart true."
91698.objectivesText: Recover a Deadwood Key from a Deadwood Warden and return to the Barkskin Cage.
91698.title: Barkskin Breakout

91725.description:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.
91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
91732.title: Good Steel

91734.description:
<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
91734.title: Remote Contact

91740.description: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.objectivesText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
91740.title: Croaky's Head

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.objectivesText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.
91745.title: Mining Consultant

91751.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.objectivesText: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain $1oa Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.objectivesText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.
91752.title: The Big Picture

conditionalDescriptions.text:
I've never seen an elf like you before!

Oh, I don't know what to do! My friend Fraxinus is sick, and I can't leave him alone!

Could you please fetch me some Untainted Soil? I can make some poultices that may help him to feel better.

91754.description:
I haven't seen |5$r like you in years!

Oh, I don't know what to do! My friend Fraxinus is sick, and I can't leave him alone!

Could you please fetch me some Untainted Soil from the uncorrupted land southeast of here? I can make some poultices that may help him to feel better.
91754.objectivesText: Collect $1oa samples of Untainted Soil from around the foothills of Mount Hyjal.
91754.title: Rub Some Dirt In It

91755.description:
Have you seen those nasty tainted shrubberies wandering around this valley?

Those plants are mean, but some of them are not entirely toxic. Their leaves can have medicinal purposes.

Would you be so kind as to fetch me some Verdant Leaves? You'll have to do a little pruning, of course.
91755.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Verdant Leaves from Tainted Shrubbery in the foothills of Mount Hyjal.
91755.title: Leaves to Ligatures

91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.objectivesText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.
91758.title: Follow That Kobold!

91770.description:
With the ingredients you brought, I can make some simple medicine. This poultice should aid Fraxinus. He is old, you know, and he was badly burned during the wars. His bark hurts and his limbs ache. He is my best friend and I just want him to feel better!

Take this poultice and apply it liberally to all of the places where his bark is split and his sap is weeping.
91770.title: Bark Bite

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
91775.title: Book Return

91858.description:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.objectivesText: Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.
91858.title: Diplomatic Incident

91862.description:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.objectivesText: Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.
91862.title: Lumina Windsinger

91877.description:
Not many demon hunters remain on Azeroth now, but a few of us continue to hunt the most dangerous or hidden threats.

A colleague of mine, Maerion Thaelemaches, headed to Hyjal to investigate rumors of demons there. While there are many demons in the dangerous Darkwhisper Gorge, there is suspicion that the demons that assaulted the mountain during the last war might not be completely defeated.

This bears investigation.
91877.objectivesText: Find Maerion Thaelemaches somewhere on Mount Hyjal.
91877.title: Demon Hunter's Hunter

91881.description:
With the warlocks under control, I'd say this area's well in wing.

<The crow nods sagely, looking pleased.>

Though our work here is done, there are other areas that could use your help and as an underwing of mine I would like you to go see what all the fuss is about.

Follow the path northwest up the road to the old tern outpost. An old friend awaits!
91881.objectivesText: Meet Sefira Everbright at the outpost.
91881.title: The Western Post

91882.description:
Years ago, the Horde and the Alliance put aside their differences to fight a greater threat--the Legion. On Mount Hyjal, the Grand Alliance forces battled Archimonde and his minions to a halt.

The retreat from the mountain was perilous, however, and some brave fighters were left behind.

Now that the way up the great mountain is again open, perhaps some of these heroes remain alive in the wilds? Go to Mount Hyjal and brave its dangers. Find what became of our forces there.
91882.objectivesText: Search Mount Hyjal for remnants of the Grand Alliance.
91882.title: The Grand Alliance

91920.description:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.objectivesText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
91920.title: Wild Eyes

91952.description:
So much corruption rains down into Felwood from above. When the waters run high from Hyjal, they are filled with fel taint. It soaks into the ground and diseases the trees and plants.

There was a druid who lived in the wild, a hermit named Ketharas, who had a deep knowledge of the mountain. If anyone knows what has happened on Hyjal, it is he.

I think that Felwood cannot heal until the problem on Hyjal is resolved.
91952.objectivesText: Find the hermit Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.
91952.title: The Source of the Corruption

92008.description:
Another new face? 

I shouldn't be surprised with the strength of our so-called wards these days. How's the fel down there? I haven't been away from this workshop in weeks. Say, while you're here, I do have some favors you may be able to help me with if you find yourself in the mood for errands.

You wouldn't believe how tricky it is to get proper parts all the way up here, let alone general building material for engineering. Nami in Everlook has a parts order waiting for me - care for a winter sprint?
92008.objectivesText: Retrieve Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order from Nami in Everlook.
92008.title: Premiere Parts

92009.description:
There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle.

Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal.

If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?

objectives.text: Shipment delivered to Mount Hyjal before it expires

92009.objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.
92009.title: Crate Expectations

92011.description:
I'm going to need some time to sort out which plans to build first. Something I've been meaning to do is hike up to the old Horde base and see what kind of treasure can be made out of whatever trash is laying around there.

If you are heading up there, and have the space to carry it, keep your eyes peeled for scrap metal, wire, or chunks of bat... droppings! Look, it has its uses okay!

You can find the remains of the horde encampment far up the mountain, even beyond the Elderwild settlement.
92011.objectivesText: Scavenge the remains of the Horde base and return $1oa Frayed Wire, $2oa Scrap Metal, and $3oa Calcified Excrement to Kaylaena.
92011.title: Rubble Rummage

92014.description:
Every time I take my attention off the supplies I've lugged up here for more than a few minutes, one of nature's finest thieves is pilfering and rummaging through it.

The damned foxes seem to have made a burrow beneath the boulders nearby. Apparently, me digging out this hole gave them an idea of their own.

I'm working on a solution. Tell you what, bring back some of their fox tails. That'll teach them a lesson, and I'll hang the tails around the perimeter to scare the others off!
92014.objectivesText: Return $1oa Rustleaf Fox Tails to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.
92014.title: Fox Hole

92017.description:
The flying creatures of the Summit still draw breath from the highest currents, where the corruption has not yet fully taken hold. Hippogryph feathers and chimaera hair drift through these winds, absorbing what the air remembers of an unspoiled land. I need these remnants to anchor and strengthen my purifying incense.

Gather them for me, so I may concentrate the wind's knowledge into cleansing smoke before we begin the ritual.
92017.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Grand Hippogryph Feathers and $2oa Oily Chimaera Hair for Marn.
92017.title: Cleansing Winds

92020.description:
I've been taking notes and making drawings in my sketchbooks of all of the creatures living in Un'Goro Crater, and I made a few copies so that I can send them to people who might be interested!

I have a sketchbook copy here that I've been meaning to get into the hands of the druids on Mount Hyjal, since I know that they love to study the natural world.

Hyjal's a bit of a trip, though. Do you think you could take it along in case you go there?
92020.objectivesText: Take Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards to a druid at the summit of Mount Hyjal.
92020.title: Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards

92064.description:
Let's try something else. You see that branch up there? Yep! That one. I need you to break it for me. I've got plenty of ropes tangled elsewhere, so there's no chance for catastrophic failure... I hope.

Take a safe step back and take a few swings at this branch, would you?

<Fenwick gestures at something above his head.>

Please be careful!
92064.objectivesText: Break the tree branch to free Fenwick Togglespring.
92064.title: Tree Free

92066.description:
When the Legashi invaded, many precious things were left behind in the commotion. Of particular value to me are two totems. They depict legends of our twin gods, Ursoc and Ursol.

I know our immediate survival is of greatest concern, but we must also think of saving our people's history.

Those totems are likely still in our former hold. If they are, you would be doing a great kindness by returning them to me.
92066.objectivesText: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside Blackmaw Hold. Then, return them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.
92066.title: The Twin Bears

92069.description:
Two behemoths patrol the place the Blackmaw once called home: Bonesnout, the Unbroken and Withermaw, the great bear. Generations of hunters have tried to fell them, and all have failed.

I take no joy in asking you to slay these magnificent beasts, but my people need to be able to return home. The least I can do is ensure their deaths are not in vain. If you bring me their remains, I will fashion a weapon in memory of their strength.
92069.objectivesText: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc, in Azshara.
92069.title: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore

92070.description:
The necklace is adorned with miscellaneous charms: scraps of feathers, acorn shells, and colorful pebbles. Its leather strap is torn. The ornamentation suggests it belonged to a Furbolg, while its small size and rough quality indicate a child's handiwork.

There's a chance the necklace is of some sentimental value to one of the Blackmaw. It may be good to find the owner and return it.
92070.objectivesText: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.
92070.title: A Lost Memento

92094.description:
My brother Fenwick and I recently finished a successful rocket test, the only problem is, he hasn't come back yet! I lost sight of him floating off to the south after his parachute deployed.

It looks like he may have landed in Hyjal!

If you help him find his way out of where he landed, I'm sure he'd find a way to thank you. I'll be grateful to have my brother back!
92094.objectivesText: Wennzut Togglespring lost sight of his brother, Fenwick, floating in his parachute into Hyjal. Look for where he may have ended up.
92094.title: Rocket Gnomes

92101.description:
Hyjal is difficult to bear. Nightmares and murderous memories linger among the craters.

But you carry warmth from Kalimdor within you! My friend Tobin also enlisted and joined up with me, but I fear the worst for his soul. 

The Alliance company gave us steeds to break in and bond with for our upcoming deployment. We took them on a joy ride through the Barrens. Carved our names into the bottom of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles.

See if the marks remain? It will bring ease to a weary soul.
92101.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's markings of significance on the Great Lift.
92101.title: Lifted by Legacy

92109.description:
Erm... 'Ello, $Gmister:miss;. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
92109.title: My First Alchemy Set

92111.description:
I see you try, and try is more than most. We give you good will with time, if you do the same.

Enter our den and talk to Osi. She has open paws, will give you more chance to help.
92111.objectivesText: Enter Barkskin Burrow and find the furbolg they call Osi.
92111.title: Of Friend and Fur

92317.description:
So, the hermit druid seeks a force to balance the 'life' in this magic of his? Then the answer is death, naturally. You have come to the right place for such a thing.

No doubt you've seen the undead crawling all over my domain. They are fueled by stolen power that animates them even in death.

That stolen power is exactly what is needed in this spell you speak of. Kill the undead and search through their skulls for a coalesced Drop of Stolen Life. Return it to Ketharas once you have it.
92317.objectivesText: Acquire a Drop of Stolen Life from the Scourge in the ruins on Mount Hyjal, then return to Ketharas.
92317.title: Stolen Life

92335.description:
This magic you seek is as complex as it is wild. It needs a reagent that can provide a stable source of continual energy, and I know of just the thing.

When Archimonde met his well-deserved end here, many of his lesser minions were also killed. His chief lieutenant, Azgalor, was slain--by mortals like you, no less!

You'll find the last physical remains of Azgalor in the middle of the ruins here. No need to bring all of that ash back to Ketharas. Just a pinch should be more than enough for his needs.
92335.objectivesText: Fetch a pinch of Azgalor's Ashes from the ruins of Dae'gun on Mount Hyjal.
92335.title: Ashes of the Legion Ascent

92343.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt.
92343.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
92343.title: Get to the Roots of It

92415.description: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415.objectivesText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.
92415.title: Remember That I Love You

92432.completionText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.description:
I bring ill tidings from Dalaran. Something has disrupted our leylines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.

We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!

Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near Dalaran beside Lordamere Lake.
92432.objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
92432.title: An Alarming Request

92433.description:
Hey! I'm pretty busy trying to turn these scraps into something edible. You wanna help out? I could really use some more variety for this meal! It sure would be nice to have something different on the menu.

There's a goblin in Everlook who has this recipe for Savory Stag Sliders... perfect for tiny hands like mine. If you could cook up some of those, that would be great! You can get stag meat from the stags here on the mountain.
92433.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Hnaz Blunderflame in Elderwild.
92433.title: Now We're Cooking

92446.description:
South of here, among da forests where I sometimes hunt, dere is a great and cunning bear. We call him Head Scratcher, as his paws have caught more dan one unsuspecting villager. He ambushes hunters who are returning with prey, striking da heads by surprise and knocking dem unconscious, then stealing da catch and running back into da forest.

He is wise to me, he knows dat I track him. But he may not know your scent yet.

Take dis carcass and lure him out. Finish him and bring back his claws.
92446.objectivesText: Take the rabbit carcass into the woods to the south, lure out Head Scratcher, defeat him, and bring his claws back to Zet'gan.
92446.title: Head Scratcher

92449.description:
Ever since we escaped the war we have struggled to secure our safety, surrounded by foes on all sides, beset by constant danger.

Our old holdout to the east is overrun with undead. These scourge meander mindlessly--a sad but dangerous remnant. Without the guidance of their commanders, they are lost... but still deadly.

Though we've tried, we have yet to succeed in eliminating their presence. At the very least, with your help, we can push them back to secure our safety... for now.
92449.objectivesText: Eliminate $1oa Forgotten Soldiers and $2oa Fleshflay Raveners.
92449.title: Blight No More

92454.description: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
92454.objectivesText: Bring the Thendal Grove Gift Voucher to Dalia Windbreeze.
92454.title: Welcome!

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92460.description:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92460.title: Coming of Age

92461.description:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461.objectivesText: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
92461.title: Harmony in Balance

92462.description:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.objectivesText: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
92462.title: Infestation Investigation

92463.description:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464.areaDescription: Learn more about the agitated winds.
92464.description:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464.objectivesText: Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
92464.title: Elemental Unrest

92465.description:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465.objectivesText: Slay $2oa Roiling Winds and $1oa Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
92465.title: Agitators

92467.description: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.$B$BThe sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.$B$BSeek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.
92467.objectivesText: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
92467.title: Call of Earth

92469.description:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
92469.title: Return to Rorian

92470.description:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470.objectivesText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
92470.title: Foul Matriarch

92471.description:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471.objectivesText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
92471.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472.description:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472.objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
92472.title: The Next Step

92473.description:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473.objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
92473.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474.description:
Well hello there, $n! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474.objectivesText: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
92474.title: Falling With Style

92480.description: The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.
92480.objectivesText: Bring the Orders from the High Priestess to Shen'Dar Village and present it to whomever is in charge there.
92480.title: zzOLD UNUSED Cult Ambush

92483.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident rogue trainer--Akeri Duskblade--has requested to speak with you. He left this note, so read that first, then seek him out inside the watchtower, here in the village.

He's a shady fellow, but then again, so are you. I think you'll get along well.
92483.objectivesText: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.
92483.title: At Home in the Shadows

92484.description: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
92484.objectivesText: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
92484.title: Embracing the Elements

92485.description:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485.objectivesText: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
92485.title: A Student of Nature

92489.description:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489.objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.
92489.title: Power Overwhelming

92500.description:
Since the shrine of Aviana has fallen into disrepair, the Wormwing harpies have snuck in and stolen the last of our druidic relics. One of these, the Jewel of the Horizon, is a sparkling blue stone blessed by the feathered goddess herself. The touch of Aviana may have just the magical power that you need for your task.

The Wormwings have doubtless hidden it in or near one of their nests. When you find it, take it to Ketharas.
92500.objectivesText: Find the Jewel of the Horizon in the Wormwing harpy nests on Mount Hyjal and bring it to Ketharas.
92500.title: A Bit of the Sky

92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.objectivesText: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
92514.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
92515.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516.description: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516.objectivesText: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92516.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92517.description:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517.objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92517.title: The Criminal Element

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92521.description:
You know I'm a warlock, right? Now reduced to squalor and meat-cutting, but once a mighty magician!

My imp keeps wandering off and while I could just call him back, I'm kinda curious about what he's doing. He's been sneaking off to talk to a bound satyr at a tower to the southeast of here. If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to know what they're talking about.

I'm sure it's nothing to worry about, but you can never tell with demons, right?
92521.objectivesText: Spy on Hnaz's imp at the tower with the captive satyr.
92521.title: The Demon Tower

92528.description:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528.objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92528.title: Among the Faithful

92529.areaDescription: Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village
92529.description:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529.objectivesText:
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
92529.title: Falaath Village

92532.description:
While you were gone our warrior trainer--Blademaster Ren--requested that we send you their way when you returned. She dropped this note off for you as well.

Give it a read, then find Blademaster Ren inside the village watchtower.
92532.objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.
92532.title: The Warrior's Path

92544.description:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544.objectivesText: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
92544.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92550.description:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550.objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
92550.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551.description:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551.objectivesText: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
92551.title: Stolen Supplies

92553.description:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Small Eggs and $2oa Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
92553.title: Restocking the Larders

92579.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92579.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92579.title: To Valanaar

92591.description:
We've tried to escape the mountain, but our attempts have always been thwarted by the Scourge. A powerful lich reanimates the remains of those we destroy and sends them against us again. So long as that lich endures, we'll never be safe.

The lich has a pile of bones from which it rebuilds skeletons. Take this torch and set fire to the bone pile in the ruins. The lich will be sure to respond.

Bring me its amulet, so that we may destroy it and be rid of the lich for good.
92591.objectivesText: Use the Survivor's Torch on the Bone Pile, then collect the Reanimator's Amulet.
92591.title: Final Death

92594.description:
While you're traveling around the mountain, I can't resist asking for another small favor...

Did you see all those fel shrubberies and plants littering the hills down below? It turns out they burn rather well, which is both good, and bad. Handy for feeding into a small furnace, but also a risk when it twists together and binds up gears...or bootstraps!

Thin their numbers on your way down, and I'll pick up the weeds myself once they've dried out.
92594.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Tainted Shrubbery for Kaylaena Springwhisper at the workshop in the Tainted Foothills.
92594.title: Kindling, Kinda

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.> 

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Even for a Shaman, you show particular aptitude in our gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.

92595.description:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595.objectivesText: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
92595.title: The Windshapers

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even for a mage such as yourself. 

Come, let us sit and speak some on the nature of the arcane and the plight of our homeland.

92596.description:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596.objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.
92596.title: The High Order

92597.description:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.

objectives.text: Use your Read Leyline ability near the Thendal Grove Leyline

92597.objectivesText: Use your Read Leyline racial ability at the leyline in Thendal Grove.
92597.title: Reading the Leylines

92598.description:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

objectives.text: Use Skysight near the Elemental Convergence

92598.objectivesText: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
92598.title: The Gift of Skysight

92609.description:
We been tryin' ta leave many a time, but keep gettin' pulled back ta defend our brothas an' sistas. Wit our defenses dwindlin', it's time we get ta restockin'.

Today we be needin' arrows. Lots an' lots o' dem.

Find dem big, beautiful birds and bring us back dem long feathers for da straight shootin' arrows.
92609.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Hyjal Owl Feathers for Zet'gan.
92609.title: Feathers in Flight

92640.description:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640.objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
92640.title: Desperate Times

92642.description:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642.objectivesText: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92642.title: Disrupting Logistics

92643.description:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.

objectives.text: Find the secluded house in Shen'dar Highlands

92643.objectivesText: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
92643.title: The Turncoat

92644.description: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644.objectivesText: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92644.title: Unfortunate News

92645.description:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645.objectivesText: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92645.title: Breaking the Breaker

92646.description:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
92646.objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
92646.title: Confront Lorthuna

92679.description:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679.objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
92679.title: Blood Tithe

92682.description:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682.objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
92682.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683.description:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683.objectivesText: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
92683.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684.description:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684.objectivesText: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
92684.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685.description:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685.objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
92685.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693.description:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

objectives.text: Follow Aamelia and make your final stand

92693.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
92693.title: Standing Our Ground

92698.description:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698.objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
92698.title: What Is My Purpose?

92700.description:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar.

You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92700.title: The Grand Skyseer

92701.description:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $n.
92701.objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92701.title: To Valanaar

92703.description:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $n. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703.objectivesText: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
92703.title: Deliver the News

92707.description:
Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.

You should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
92707.objectivesText: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
92707.title: The Giant in the Den

92708.description:
The Windshapers have been hard at work trying to respond to the current crisis on Zephras Isle. We have made several surprising discoveries in our search for the missing wind spirits, and we are developing a plan of action that could help us gain the means to save the island.

We'll need strong young adventurers like yourself for this to work however. Please, if you have a moment, let us speak on this further.
92708.objectivesText: Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
92708.title: A Grand Adventure

92709.description: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and it's youths like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709.objectivesText: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
92709.title: A Grand Adventure

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92747.description:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $n, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747.objectivesText: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
92747.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92749.description:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749.objectivesText: Obtain $1oa Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
92749.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750.description:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750.objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
92750.title: Detonation at a Distance

92754.description:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
92754.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring $1oa Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.
92754.title: A New Need for Shadow Protection

92755.description:
With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.

While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
92755.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring $1oa Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
92755.title: Mysterious Mysticism

92833.description:
Ve'han now claims the Nordrassil Lodge, under the boughs of the great tree, as his lair. It is time for us to put this magic to the ultimate test.

Take the staff and bring it to bear against Ve'han. Dispel the magic protecting him and bring him to justice!
92833.objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain to strip Ve'han Talongrasp of his stolen power, then destroy him.
92833.title: Ve'han's Fall

92834.description:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

It's clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834.objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.
92834.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840.description:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840.objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.
92840.title: Catching Wind

92842.description:
I have a cousin who, some time ago, mentioned a plan to visit Mount Hyjal and see what has been happening there. Foolishly.

Hyjal is a world away; it could take months for mail to reach him, if he can even find a mailbox.

In the unlikely event that you find yourself on that side of the world, I would appreciate someone looking in on my fool of a cousin.
92842.objectivesText: Find the missing cousin somewhere on Mount Hyjal.
92842.title: A Cousin Abroad

92846.description:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.
92846.title: Outcast Necromancers

92849.description: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>

objectives.text: Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies

92849.title: The Missing Scholar

92850.description:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850.objectivesText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.
92850.title: The Missing Scholar

92860.description:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92860.title: In Service of Zephras

92871.description:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871.objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
92871.title: In Service of Zephras

92872.description:
We eternally guard this tomb and the knowledge of ceremonial rites used to honor these fallen souls.

Now that you've descended three levels below the earth, you take your first steps toward returning to the sunlit world with sacred wisdom.

Each season, we carry some of the dust from this tomb and spread it to the oceans of Azeroth. A symbolic act of renewing cycles.

Take this small satchel. Travel to the cliffs behind Stromgarde Keep and cast it into the sea.

objectives.text: Pouch of Tomb Dust thrown into the sea behind Stromgarde

92872.objectivesText: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.
92872.title: Dutiful Steps

92873.description:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, then bring $1oa Well Cursed Bones from a successful ritual back to Orgrul.
92873.title: Proof of Concept

92878.description:
<The forsaken points to his missing lower jaw. He then hands you a piece of paper with a hastily scrawled message.>

Can't talk. Lost jaw in fight. Attacked by Grimtotems. Led by a druid. Namida. Camp to northwest.

She must pay.

<The last sentence is underlined twice.>
92878.objectivesText: Bring proof of Namida Grimtotem's demise to Blaise Montgomery at Camp Mojache.
92878.title: Lost for Words

92880.description:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880.objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
92880.title: Return to Valanaar

92881.description:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881.objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
92881.title: The High Elder's Request

92893.description:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and slay $1oa Gelkis Captives scattered around the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul after the task is complete.
92893.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92894.description:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram Clan, and use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to fully raise undead that are struggling to emerge throughout the Valley of Bones. Return to Orgrul once the Magram army has grown.
92894.title: Bone Raising

92910.description: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910.objectivesText: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.
92910.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92914.description:
<You approach the strange crystal, guarded mere moments ago by emaciated mana elementals.

Its pedestal, though ancient, is noticeably less dilapidated than the elven ruins it is built upon.

A weak hum of power radiates from the fractured gemstone, but with its magic so heavily depleted its purpose will ultimately remain a mystery for the time being.

Perhaps there is more to discover nearby.>
92914.objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.
92914.title: Strange Pylons

92947.description:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
92947.title: Making Our Move

93016.description:
You will have to forgive me for sending you on such a series of tasks without providing any context. I hadn't considered how suspicious this may have seemed, more so now that the skies have taken on such a dramatic appearance.

I will gladly answer your questions.
93016.objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.
93016.title: A Brief History Lesson

93030.description:
I once was a knight like you--bound to the service of the light. Then, I died. It seems that we both have that much in common.

Unlike you, however, I am bound to this place by a purpose unfinished, an oath unfulfilled. If you would listen, I would tell you of my quest... and my failure.
93030.objectivesText: Speak with the Knight of Mourning to learn more about his unfinished quest.
93030.title: The Knight of Mourning

93034.description:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $n. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
93034.title: Valley of Bones
