94829.description:
If you've come to demand more of our crop, you're too late. No doubt you saw my farm. Destroyed. All of it.

Good folk toiled in these fields for years to feed troops and civilians alike. But when those cultists arrived, where was the military? Where was our promised protection after all the rations they'd taken from us?

If you've any sense of decency, I beg you. The least we can do is recover their belongings from those cursed raiders. Let my people rest with their kin in the graveyard to the west.
94829.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Farmers' Mementos from Twilight Raiders and place them on the graves west of Elbrim's Farm.
94829.title: What We Lost

94832.description:
Unfortunately I haven't had much luck with identifying the ring's owner to bring closure to their family.

Perhaps Daythor can be of assistance. He knew the others of our regiment quite well.

I only hope it does not bring back unpleasant memories...
94832.objectivesText: Show the ring to Daythor Brellan.
94832.title: Belle's Ring

94861.areaDescription: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.description:
Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.
94861.objectivesText: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.title: Helping Hands

94864.description:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion. 

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Young Forest Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
94864.title: Taming the Beast

94872.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94877.description:
When you look around you, what do you see? A broken home and a tired people.

Stormwind has left us to fend for ourselves, and we have less to do that with every day. Many within these walls are refugees who barely escaped tragedy without so much as even their own families.

Farholde is no Stormwind, stranger. We lost a settlement in the northwest to the Twilight's Hammer, but we will not let them keep it. If you wish to fight, go to Sunnyglade and purge those savages from our lands.
94877.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders, $2oa Twilight Shadowmancers, and $3oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Demar Brant.
94877.title: Saving Sunnyglade

94879.description:
You've seen the ruined city to the north, yes? Sunnyglade? Demar tries sending troops, but we're no closer to reclaiming it. I have a better idea.

In truth, this attack by the Twilight's Hammer is not the first. They seem to be coordinating from a centralized location, and I would know where. While you're out doing what you adventurers do best, see if you can't keep an eye out for any documents they may have misplaced. With enough of them, I should be able to piece together their intentions.
94879.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twilight Pages from within Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberall in Farholde Keep.
94879.title: Scraps of Knowledge

94881.description:
My, what have we here? A brave new $c come to save us from our woes? How charming! Maybe you can help me with something then? I'd quite like to learn more about this cult in Sunnyglade.

Like any cult, they operate in a caste system. Those with an affinity for magic are often in high favor and are given tokens to demonstrate such. These charms are then imbued, and thus have a rich abundance of cultist magic.

I wish to see these tokens for myself. Be a dear and see if you can bring me a few, hmm?
94881.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Twilight Charms from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade for Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep.
94881.title: Curious Trinkets

94885.description:
The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. 

The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements.

Someone in Farholde will want to see this.
94885.objectivesText: Deliver the Field Marshal's Log to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94885.title: Field Marshal's Log

94890.description:
With this kind of momentum, we can't stop now. The soldiers we rescued are itching to draw blood, and you've already proven yourself a capable battering ram.

Return to the Twilight's Shroud and finish what we've started. Their leader, an orc by the name of Overlord Kilgar, hides deep within his keep while his underlings are lost in their panic.

If we want to put an end to this, bring me the head of Kilgar. These gods-fearing cowards can't make a single decision on their own.
94890.objectivesText: Defeat Overlord Kilgar within the Twilight's Shroud and bring his head to Sergeant Riftan.
94890.title: Bring Me His Head

94892.completionText: Return to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.description:
It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him...

<Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.>

I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...
94892.objectivesText: Return Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
94892.title: Dying Wish

94895.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to Friz Frazzlespark. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
94895.objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
94895.title: Lost Shipping Crate

94896.description:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.
94896.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897.description:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him, bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.objectivesText: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94898.description:
When our home started to fall into the sky that fateful night, it's as if the elements themselves were waiting to consume us. Wind spirits began appearing as we were fleeing, and to our dismay they began attacking the fleeing survivors.

We lost many villagers to the sky, but even more to the relentless anger of those wind spirits. I don't know if it was our village falling into the sky, but they are extremely dangerous.

If you are able, please put them to rest.
94898.title: Violent Winds (Temp Disabled)

94907.description:
You've been such a good little $c for me, I wonder if I could ask you to do one more small favor.

With the reagents you collected being so finely attuned to Twilight's Hammer magic, they are perfect for a summoning ritual. However, we'll need to take them to the source of their power.

Should you happen upon a conduit while you're gallivanting about the Twilight's Shroud, see if you can't call upon one of the cult's thralls and capture it with this soulstone for me. For questioning, of course.
94907.objectivesText: Summon a Twilight's Thrall from a conduit within the Twilight Shroud and capture it with Amberhall's Soulstone.
94907.title: A Small Favor

94911.description:
Greetings, young $r. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.objectivesText: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
94911.title: Child of Nature

94913.description: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
94913.title: Moonglade

94923.description:
<Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.>

Psst! Hey $gmister:miss;, I need your help!

My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was!

It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!
94923.objectivesText: Find Robbie's Hat somewhere along the river near the murlocs.
94923.title: Hats Off

94925.description:
Farholde prides itself on its independence, but there are a few things we can only get through trade.

We've negotiated an arrangement with a dealer at Powderfuse Port. We provide her with goods that are dangerous to acquire, and she provides us with specialty munitions.

Currently, she's in the market for lion fur. A pride of them live atop a large hill in the center of the plains. If you'd like to make yourself useful, you could aid me in harvesting some of their hides.
94925.objectivesText: Bring 8 Prized Lion Hides to Watcher Terral.
94925.title: A Fur Trade

94926.description:
Like most ogre weaponry, this hammer is large, unwieldy, and well-worn. A creature of any other race could hardly swing it at all.

To you, it is of little more use than a trophy, but perhaps someone at Farholde would appreciate knowing of Komuk's demise.
94926.objectivesText: Take Komuk's Maul to Farholde Keep as proof of the ogre's demise.
94926.title: Drop the Hammer

94927.areaDescription: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok
94927.description:
When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight.

Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man.
94927.objectivesText: Help Dunston break out of Bolder'ok then return to Watcher Cornelius.
94927.title: Dunston Checks Out

94928.description:
These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
94928.objectivesText: Deliver the Bundle of Lion Hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
94928.title: A Few Furs for Friz

94929.description:
I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. It's a shipment of utmost urgency.

An old acquaintance resides in a keep within the Riverglades. To get there, travel northeast through the bogs avoiding the deadly creatures within. Along the northeastern hillside sits an old path. Travel its road all the way through the hills and when you hit the fork in the road stay north, then east. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore.

I thank you for your aid.
94929.objectivesText: Bring the Shipment to Demar Brant at Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.
94929.title: Deliver the Second Shipment

94946.description:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.objectivesText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.
94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94961.description:
<The gnoll pulls a bit of gold from his pocket and waves it at you.>

$R, I offer trade! There is more where this came from. Help me get revenge, and I will show you!
94961.objectivesText: Bring 20 Twilight Finger Bones to Fuzzle.
94961.title: Biting the Hand

94962.description:
Alright, so you got a few wins under your belt. So what?

You're a long way from becoming the champ, bub. But I tell ya what--I'll make sure this next battle ain't one you'll soon forget.

Hope you're ready for a surprise.
94962.objectivesText: Defeat Bonegnaw in the Bloodmaster's Ring.
94962.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

94963.description:
Come, $r. It is time to leave this place. If any try to stop us, we will tear them to shreds!

Once we are safe, I will take you to your reward.
94963.title: Biting the Hand

94972.description:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.
94972.objectivesText: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
94972.title: Tome of Twilight

94980.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94980.objectivesText: Find someone in Farholde Keep who may know about the mould.
94980.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94981.description:
The moulding is rather crude, but we may be able to fashion a key with the right materials.

I'll keep the embers running hot while you gather the necessary components.
94981.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Thick Leather and $2oa Iron Bars to Alphonse Dumas.
94981.title: Key Ingredients

94984.description:
No matter our efforts, the Twilight forces persist. We've deduced they must be coming from somewhere else.

With the new pet you brought me, I was able to politely ask our dear Twilight Thrall if it knew anything about where its former masters were coming from. Of note was mention of shadow magics and an ogre by the name of Nar'gurk in a hidden stronghold north of Sunnyglade.

Seek him out. Kill him and recover what you can. There must be something we can learn from these efforts.
94984.objectivesText: Kill Nar'gurk within Krol'dok Stronghold and recover any valuable information.
94984.title: Tome of Twilight

94992.areaDescription: Escort the lost horse to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.description: <The horse bows its head in your direction then nudges its nose into your underarm. Wherever you go, it may follow.>
94992.objectivesText: Bring the lost horse back to Wheeler's Grange.
94992.title: Rescue Roundup

94998.description:
Quite simple to dispel, really. Remnants of something, that's for sure. What, exactly, I do not know.

Well, I'm afraid I've done all that I can. I'm sorry if you were expecting more from me, but... on second thought, the craftsmanship of these is quite unique. Perhaps they could be of some use.

Take these to Melanie Sable. Tell her I sent you. Let her know they're safe.

She may have some use for them just yet.
94998.objectivesText: Bring the Satchel of Mementos to Melanie Sable.
94998.title: Curios of Curiosity

95027.description:
We always need more arrows for hunting and fighting, and for feathers, we use the white feathers of the Hyjal owl. They're naturally fluffy and soft, but I stiffen them up with a mixture designed to make them perfect for fletching.

You can get feathers from the owls, of course, but they also leave behind feathers in their nests, which you can find all over to the south of here.

Bring back a bundle of feathers, all right?
95027.objectivesText: Head south into the valley and collect owl feathers from their nests.
95027.title: Feathers in Flight

95033.description:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.
95033.objectivesText: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
95033.title: On the Other Side

95034.description:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.objectivesText: Speak with Lumina Windsinger in the Sepulcher.
95034.title: The Debt

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95041.description:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.objectivesText: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.
95041.title: Data Hoarders

95062.description:
Time for a special delivery.

Old Krom'rosh is waiting for this package over at Rog'mar just west of here.

I suggest you get it to him quickly, but carefully. Why, you might ask? It's better to not ask questions.
95062.objectivesText: Deliver Frazzlespark's Crate to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95062.title: Frazzlespark's Crate

95063.description:
Ok, listen up. You've showed quite a bit of prowess in the ring. You've managed to upset Chub'chob more than words can explain. Sure glad I ain't you right now.

Just in case you was wonderin', I should remind you that your entry fee does not cover accidental death.

It's been great knowin' ya, but you're on your own from here on out, bub.

Best of luck to ya.
95063.objectivesText: Defeat Chub'chob, Bloodmaster of Bolder'ok, in the Bloodmaster's Ring, then share the news of becoming the newly crowned champion of the Bloodmaster's Ring with Clugfist at Bolder'ok.
95063.title: Bloodmaster's Ring

95064.description:
The orcs have become an encroaching threat ever since their arrival. First, claiming the lands by the river and now their presence grows within the plains...

I'll never understand their kind, nor do I care, truth be told, but I'll be damned if they think there's more ground to be taken.
95064.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Rog'mar Trainees for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95064.title: Preventative Measures

95066.description:
The message we've delivered is clear.

Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.
95066.objectivesText: Deliver the report to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
95066.title: The Rog'mar Situation

95107.description:
One chief of the Deadwood, Deeproar, barks in the depths of their den. He was once of no burrow, and in a night of bad blood, he fell sway to their spells.

Now, he feeds on their sour sap, with twice the cursed roar.

Go. End his foul ways. Take his staff and bring it here, so I know he holds it no more.
95107.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Deeproar and return his staff to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow.
95107.title: Deeproar Down

95108.description:
With far sight, we have seen their den. Deadwood brew dark rites in their pots. They feed this foul mix to their young, so bad roots take. Then they learn to fight with vile ways.

Go, stop this spread. Slay the dark ones and smash their stew.
95108.objectivesText: Kill two Deadwood Death Mystics and destroy two Deadwood Cauldrons within Deadwood Den.
95108.title: Mystic Mix

95111.description:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well-known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.objectivesText: Speak with Ott and ask him to forge your blade.
95111.title: An Underrated Talent

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95120.description:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.
95120.objectivesText: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95120.title: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95122.description:
Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground.

They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.
95122.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Eastsea Raiders and $2oa Eastsea Bombardiers for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95122.title: Unchecked Expansion

95123.description:
As much as I love seeing Eastsea heads roll, we also gotta take out their ships. Can't have 'em running off for reinforcements, now can we?

I've got a plan for that, but we're gonna need some gunpowder. A LOT of it.

The pirates are probably storing some near the freshly-demolished Winstead to the north. See if you can get your hands on it. I'll fill you in on the rest later.
95123.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Eastsea Powder Kegs for Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95123.title: A Blast Ye Scurvy Dogs!

95125.description:
These are some truly fine materials, $c. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.objectivesText: Watch as Ott forges your blade.
95125.title: Ott's Masterwork

95140.description:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.objectivesText: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest.
95140.title: Old Fire-Eye

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95144.description:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!
95144.objectivesText: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
95144.title: Overseas Delivery

95147.description:
You... where did you come from? You shouldn't be here!

<Bolain struggles through the pain--bruised, battered, and a disease-ridden bite wound to his leg.>

Take this to Dalton. Head north up the road and east where the plains open wider than this gash in my damn leg. I'd tell you to tell him he was right, but I won't give him that satisfaction... at least not until after I'm dead.

I hate these damn hills!
95147.objectivesText: Deliver Bolain's message to Captain Dalton at Southern Watch.
95147.title: The Lost Scout

95156.description:
Our training dummies are starting to show significant wear and tear. If we don't fix them up soon I worry our recruits may be unprepared for battle.

If you hadn't seen it on your way in, there's a small farmstead just outside the keep run by a man by the name of Wheeler. He may have a few extra bushels of hay he'd be willing to part with.

I'll see to it he's compensated if he's able to spare supplies for our efforts.
95156.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bundles of Hay for Ember at the training grounds.
95156.title: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em

95162.description:
With so little land not claimed by the humans or Twilight's Hammer, this ranch is one of our very few sources of food. Ogres aren't much in the way of farmers, but they love a good paletusk roast, and have agreed to let me stay so long as the meat keeps coming.

As our war advances, the demand for food is only ever increasing. Now I hardly have enough food to keep these ogres from looking at me like I'm their next meal.

If we want to have enough meat for Rog'mar, I'll need your help with the harvest.
95162.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Chunks of Boar Meat for Na'zok near Bolder'ok.
95162.title: Paletusk Harvesting

95163.description:
As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away.

Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.
95163.objectivesText: Return $1oa Young Paletusks to Na'zok's farm near Bolder'ok.
95163.title: Drive Them Back

95165.description:
So, here's how we're gonna sink those ships. 

I can use that gunpowder you stole and make timed charges. All you've gotta do is hop on each of the Eastsea's boats, and plant one charge in the hull of each. Look for a spot near their cannons, that gunpowder'll make our explosives even more powerful. Once the charges are set, get outta there, and I'll hit the detonator!

The elegance of the plan is in its simplicity, don't ya think?
95165.objectivesText: Plant a remote explosive charge on each of the Eastsea's three boats.
95165.title: See Ya, Scallywags!

95181.description:
Quiet down!

<Azka snaps, adjusting her gaze in your direction.>

I'll have your head before you give away my position to the cultists.

Watch your step and keep a low tone when traveling through these hills. Otherwise I'll be sending a report to Krom'rosh that another of our own has been taken.

Now take this and get out of here quickly... and quietly! Krom'rosh is waiting on this report. You can find him and the others at the outpost inland to the east.
95181.objectivesText: Deliver Azka's message to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95181.title: Twilight Scouting Report

95183.description:
You want ogre weapon? Me know no. You small. Can't hold good.

You bring Hamur more rocks, me make you tiny weapon. Good for tiny creature.

Find good rocks for good weapon. Hamur has discerning eye. Not just any rock will do. Find rocks near river outside Bolder'ok.
95183.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Good Rocks for Hamur in Bolder'ok.
95183.title: Step One: Rock

95189.completionText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.objectivesText: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95194.description:
Greetings, $n. There's a matter that SI:7 could use your help with. Our man on Theramore Isle tells us that Jaina Proudmoore's marines just brought in a man found washed up on the shore.

Normally this wouldn't be of much interest to us but it seems that this man told the marines that he was none other than the king of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. Go to Theramore and meet a dwarf named Sully at the inn. He's expecting you and will give you instructions when you arrive.

Find out what's going on.
95194.objectivesText: Seek out the SI:7 agent stationed on Theramore Isle.
95194.title: Our Man in Theramore

95196.description: Listen up. I'm going to walk out that door behind you. Yer gonna wait until I'm good and gone, and then yer gonna meet me behind the graveyard outside o' town. Ensure yer not followed.
95196.objectivesText: Meet Sully McCleary in Dustwallow Marsh and learn more about your mission.
95196.title: Watch Yer Back

95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.objectivesText: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95212.description:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.objectivesText: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectivesText: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.title: The New Plague

95218.description:
The Light has forsaken me. A purpose served, and now everything... gone...

It's just a matter of time until the light turns to darkness.

I fought against the demons and scourge forces with a ferocity I did not know the Light could produce... and yet, I sit here, talking to you, feeling... well, I can't quite put it into words. Some reclaim their purpose after loss, yet I struggle... After all, I am only who I am.

Now, unless the commander has one last call to action, I await what comes next.
95218.title: More of the Same

95219.description:
Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world?

This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot.

One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?
95219.objectivesText: Deliver the Cask of Powderfuse Port to Mardrack Greenwell at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
95219.title: From Port to Port

95248.description:
You cut down so many of da Scourge dat we finally have a little safety. For dat, we be thankful.

One more thing. We know dat there are druids at da summit. Dey protect da great tree and da well.

How come dey never helped us?

We been here five years! Why did dey never even send a message to anyone about us? Let someone know dat we still here, we still alive!
95248.objectivesText: Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.
95248.title: To the Summit of Eternity

95254.description:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz
95254.objectivesText: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
95254.title: WANTED: Trapclaw

95260.description:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.
95260.objectivesText: Find someone at Powderfuse Port who can identify the monster from the painted hide.
95260.title: Terrors From the Deep

95261.description:
That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories!

We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait...

Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.
95261.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Beast Entrails and $2oa Rotflesh Mushrooms for Argo Brinewhistle.
95261.title: It Takes Guts

95262.description:
Can't say I've ever thought much about Alcaz. Near as I can tell, it's an abandoned outpost from the third war of little significance. Never heard nuthin' about a prison there. 

Well, there's nothing for it--we've got to get you in there and see what you can see, especially if there's a chance that the king is there.

objectives.text: Learn what became of Varian Wrynn

95262.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind.
95262.title: The Secret Prison

95263.description: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. This is devastating news and will shake Stormwind to its core. You need to return to Sully and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>
95263.objectivesText: Return to Sully McCleary in Dustwallow Marsh.
95263.title: Somber News

95264.description: Shaw needs to know as soon as possible. Head back to Stormwind and deliver the news. Please, I beg ye, tell no one else. This could be disastrous for Stormwind and it needs to be handled delicately.
95264.objectivesText: Bring the news to Matthias Shaw in Stormwind.
95264.title: Shaw Needs To Know

95278.description:
The threat is greater than we thought. Rog'mar must be warned.

Do not stop for anyone on your path.
95278.objectivesText: Deliver the missive to Krom'rosh at Rog'mar.
95278.title: It Is Time, Brother...

95293.description:
Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people.

Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.
95293.objectivesText: Deliver The Friz Special to Captain Bentcoin in Eastwind Shore.
95293.title: Smuggler's Special

95294.description:
Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day.

Run along back to your master, $c. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
95294.objectivesText: Return to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.
95294.title: Smuggler's Bargain

95295.description:
Ya did good with those pirates, lackey. But here's a lesson for ya you may want to remember. What some may call a pirate, others call a freebooter. And you can't spell freebooter without free booty. And there's no better place for free booty than Booty Bay!

<Friz waits for your reply.>

Keep up with me here, kid. I'm sayin' I need you to go to Booty Bay to meet with my contact. He gets goods from the local pirates there-- err, freebooters. Look, just go find Ruzzgot. He'll explain the rest.
95295.objectivesText: Speak to Friz's contact in Booty Bay.
95295.title: I Know a Guy

95296.completionText: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris
95296.description:
Sounds like you're ready for your next lesson, champ. I got some negotiatin' of my own to do here in town, so I need you to run a few errands for me while I'm busy.

All I need you to do is take the next ship over there by the docks and deliver this crate to my associate in Steamwheedle Port.

Don't gimme that look. It'll be plenty excitin', I'm sure. Gettin' a goblin to pay his dues is much harder than roughin' up the local riffraff, not to mention gettin' through customs. You'll figure it out.
95296.objectivesText: Speak with Wharfmaster Steamfizzle at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
95296.title: Shipping and Handling

95312.completionText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan
95312.description:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.
95312.objectivesText: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.
95312.title: Coming to Collect

95314.description:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95316.description:
Alright dirtwalker, you may have noticed the combination of pinecones and fel-infused slime is quite disgusting, if you ask me. It is, however, also very dangerous-- which is just what we need!

Take these pinecones and carefully--I repeat, carefully--make your way to the nearby warlock encampment. Once there, use these items to wreak havoc upon their precious workstations.

I am sure the results will be amusing for you to watch firsthand! This should certainly slow them down.
95316.objectivesText: Use the pinecones to destroy the Ashen Reign workstations.
95316.title: The Experimental Method

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Listen, demon caster. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. Like you, they taint the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what your fellows have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?

95317.description:
Listen, $c. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. They are tainting the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what our mysterious fel 'friends' have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?
95317.title: Notation, Notation, Notation

95322.description:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?
95322.objectivesText: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.
95322.title: Get the Goods

95330.description:
My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say.

There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet.

If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.
95330.objectivesText: Deliver Cassandra's surplus farm goods to Halligan Turner at Turner's Logging Camp.
95330.title: Love Thy Neighbor

95349.description:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $n.
95349.objectivesText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.
95349.title: The Earthen Ring

95350.description:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $n.
95350.objectivesText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.
95350.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95378.description:
It is time to cut off the heads of this hydra, if you catch my meaning.

There are three leaders who need to be killed in order to slow the operations here. Conveniently, they also need to be slain to remove the wards on my cage.

Tyaeha can be found in the House of Diseases by the creepy tree. Dazka is in the Alchemist ward with all the potions, and that fool Frezzlie is undoubtedly next to the slime pits along the northern ridge of the encampment.

Go slay them and bring me their bones!
95378.objectivesText: Retrieve the bones of Frezzlie Popwhiz, Tyaeha Darkoath and Dazka Shadowsleep.
95378.title: The Hydra's Head

95379.description:
Brashann Grimdark, Master of Vessels.

<Felflick's mouth curls into a snarl.>

He was the one to subjugate me at the summit. HE is the reason I am here in the first place.

His work with these fel-ash crystals are the backbone of this operation. He's been obsessively experimenting with anchoring souls in these crystals and his work has not gone unnoticed by those Blackthorne creeps.

Use this pristine crystal to drain his power, then put an end to him and bring me his soulstone.
95379.objectivesText: Slay Brashann Grimdark and search his body for his soulstone.
95379.title: A Revenge So Sweet

95383.description:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.
95383.objectivesText: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.
95383.title: Shipping and Handling

95384.description: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
95384.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95384.title: Partial Mystical Notes

95385.description: <Faint magic emanates from the scrap of scroll. The language is unfamiliar, though you intuit that it is not dangerous. Most would find the parchment useless, but there may be a unique collector that may find some use out of it.>
95385.objectivesText: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.
95385.title: Torn Mystical Scroll

95418.description:
Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now.

Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime?

Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.
95418.objectivesText: Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
95418.title: Spread the Word

95425.description:
Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon.

But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him!

That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion!
95425.objectivesText: Collect Skullthumper from Klunk for Clugfist in Bolder'ok.
95425.title: Unworthy Champion

95431.description:
As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this.

I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.
95431.objectivesText: Look for the Bolder'ok ogre in the nearby cave.
95431.title: Rumblings of Discontent

95454.description:
My good axe arm is broken and most of my elites are dead. The honor of the Kor'kron rests with you now.

We were sent here to extract a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... We are here for the King of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. We intercepted information that he was being held here and our Warchief commanded us to bring him back to Orgrimmar alive. The presence of black dragons... complicates things.

I need you to press on and find Wrynn. I will wait for you here while you search for him.

objectives.text: Read the note on the ground

95454.objectivesText: Look for King Varian Wrynn in Alcaz Prison.
95454.title: The Honor of the Kor'kron

95483.description:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.
95483.objectivesText: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
95483.title: Thrall Needs to Know

95494.description:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectivesText: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495.description:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.objectivesText: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
95495.title: The Hermit Tanner

95534.description:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >

objectives.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

95534.objectivesText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95555.description: <A sickly energy emanates from the staff, wholly warping the natural flow of magic around you. Despite the disturbance, you cannot seem to put it down. Distantly, you notice a similar, equally foul energy resonating, drawing you in. Perhaps you can find the source of this cursed item.>
95555.objectivesText: Find the source of corruption from the staff in Feralas.
95555.title: Corrupted Nature

95561.description:
<The loud cries of baby Dawnbright echo through Farholde Keep. Tessa looks at you with a tired smile.>

Oh, hello there adventurer. Sorry for the noise. Little Emma here seems to be quite fussy today, but I'm not sure why. Maybe some food will help.

Do you think you could help me find something for her to eat? My husband stepped out to get some supplies so my hands are a little too full to get them myself. If you could find a few apples around here I could make a lovely mash for her.
95561.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Fresh Apples for Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95561.title: Apple of My Eye

95599.description:
<The key is covered in a thick layer of rust, suggesting that the key has been underwater for a significant amount of time.

There must be a matching lock somewhere nearby to use it on but you'll have to search for it. Perhaps the pool of water to the southwest of this camp might be a good place to start?>
95599.objectivesText: Find the old chest that the key belongs to nearby in Feralas.
95599.title: The Old Key

95601.description:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>
95601.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Empowered Brutes and $2oa Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.
95601.title: The Purple Ones

95611.description:
One cannot take without giving in return. This is the cycle of life.

You have done well, $n. Thanks to your efforts, the wildlife on the mountain will continue to thrive.

Now, it is time we show our respect for these lands by offering the unused remains back to the ground.

Take this bundle and visit the shrine to the west. You shall recognize it as a simple pair of standing stones. Return to me once the ritual is complete.
95611.objectivesText: Bury the remains at Ketharas' shrine.
95611.title: Rites of Respect

95621.description:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.

objectives.text: Learn why the Kul Tirans are here

95621.objectivesText: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.
95621.title: Trouble in the Valley

95647.description:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman

95647.objectivesText: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
95647.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95663.description:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663.objectivesText: Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
95663.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664.description: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectivesText: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95682.description:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.objectivesText: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.title: Open the Maw

95737.description:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.objectivesText: Speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737.title: Seeking Caitlin

95748.description:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95753.description:
<The totem pulses with wild magic. The image of a ghostly wolf appears in your mind, beckoning you. 

It appears to be offering you a challenge.

Another totem--a twin to the one that your hand now rests upon, appears in the distance just beyond the large sun-bleached skeleton nearby.>
95753.objectivesText: Reach the other Odd Totem at the end of the massive skeleton before time runs out.
95753.title: Challenge of the Desert Wolf

95766.description:
The cycle of renewal has finally begun. The ancients... shall rise again, and the power of the natural world take its course... to bloom.

You... have helped us tip the scales in nature's favor. Perhaps... we can yet make a larger impact... on a more dire situation.

Head west... where the land itself is ashen... and you may find an entity who can help. She may look like just a small bird... but her power is great.
95766.objectivesText: Find the strange bird in the corrupted lands on the southwest slope.
95766.title: Fine Feathered Friend

95769.description:
Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit!

We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
95769.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Bolts of Runecloth to Mez'dan in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.
95769.title: Threading a Solution

95772.description:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772.objectivesText: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
95772.title: Songblade Search

95773.description:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.
95773.title: Enemies in the Water

95774.description:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.objectivesText: Slay quilboars and collect $1oa of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95775.description:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.description:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectivesText: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95788.description:
The Skullsplitter fetishes Brother Nimetz sent with you are indeed powerful, though I do not think they contributed to Kurzen's condition, or at least not directly.

Still, if the rumors are true and the lost troll city of I'lalai has indeed risen from its watery grave, it is possible the dark magics used to raise the doomed city may be related.

If you dare to venture into the Drowned City of I'lalai, please gather any troll fetishes you find and bring them here to me for further study.
95788.objectivesText: Collect $1oa I'lalai Fetishes from trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.title: Magics of the Drowned City

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95792.description:
If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there.

There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really.

If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!
95792.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Cinderscale Whelps and $2oa Cinderscale Warriors for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95792.title: Clear 'em Out

95795.description:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795.title: Fallen in the Fen

95799.description:
I must write my colleague in Ironforge at the Explorer's League immediately. This is a discovery of historical proportions.

Would you mind delivering the letter to Ironforge for me? I will write a copy of my translations of the tablets for you.
95799.objectivesText: Bring Loremaster Dibbs' I'lalai Translations to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.
95799.title: Findings for the Explorer's League

95803.description:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.objectivesText: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
95803.title: A Token of Good Faith

95805.description:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805.objectivesText: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!
95805.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95809.description:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809.objectivesText: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95809.title: Heartwoven

95816.description:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
95816.objectivesText: Bring the completed form to Elaine Compton in Redridge Mountains.
95816.title: Sign Me Up!

95818.description:
We can get ye sorted out and out of here in no time, provided you have the materials on hand! We are going to need $1oa Mithril Bars and $2oa Heavy Leather. Normally we need some other metals and the like too, but I've got some scrap that's been taking up space we can use for those extra bits.

Oh, as a personal favor, I am gonnae ask for $3oa Goldthorn as well. My wife knows a great recipe for tea and I'd like to surprise her. Consider this your payment!
95818.objectivesText: Bring the requested materials to Rotgath Stonebeard near the Great Forge in Ironforge.
95818.title: A Quick Craft

95882.description:
An Alliance scouting party has been seen on a small island northeast of Rog'mar. They are led by a scoutmaster who has made tracking enemy movements increasingly difficult. The bastard even named his filthy pet after me as an open mockery. He knows I'm hunting him.

This human has eyes everywhere, and they need to be put out. I already claimed one before he managed to flee. Bring me his other as proof that the scoutmaster is no more. Show him he is not as untouchable as he thinks.

-- Neza Bloodsnout
95882.objectivesText: Bring the Scoutmaster's Eye to Neza Bloodsnout in Rog'mar.
95882.title: WANTED: Scoutmaster Vargas

95883.description:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.objectivesText: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
95883.title: The Tortured Soul

95912.description:
With each orc we cut down, another takes its place--somehow even more capable than the last. A skilled warrior must be training this new generation. If we are to make a dent in their numbers, we need to ensure they don't have a chance to recoup their losses.

If any soldier is brave enough, it's imperative we find this blademaster and put an end to him. He is likely at the trainee camp north of the Horde outpost even now. Kill him, take his banner, and destroy the orcs' morale.

-- Ember Bladewhisper
95912.objectivesText: Bring the Blademaster's Banner to Ember Bladewhisper in Farholde Keep.
95912.title: WANTED: Blademaster Kaijo

95925.description:
$C, we've made the discovery of a lifetime! I can't believe it; the ruins in Un'Goro are open!

We've already sent a team but they have encountered... trouble. If you're headed in there anyway would ya be able to finish this map?

It sounds like there's an Achromatic Crystal in there and an unearthed watcher somewhere near a giant Western Gate that sounds interesting.

The other landmarks that would be helpful are the Pillar of Assimilation, the Western Gate and the Regrowth Vestibule.
95925.objectivesText: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each.
95925.title: Mapping the Way Forward

95926.description:
You there! I have a job for someone of your... skills.

I have gotten word from my sources of a crystal found in Shaper's Terrace that can seemingly drain the elements around it. Or perhaps it can drain life essence itself. It is unclear from this report.

I must have a fragment of this crystal! Just think of the applications of such a powerful artifact.

Go to Shaper's Terrace and bring me back a sample of this colorless Achromatic Crystal, and I will reward you for your efforts.
95926.objectivesText: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.
95926.title: The Dark Crystal

95928.description:
Ah, it is good you have come here, $c.

I have been studying crystals of late and word has reached me about a peculiar set of crystals said to be from Un'Goro Crater. I have samples of the most basic ones, but I have heard tell of larger more potent crystals seen in a place called Shaper's Terrace.

I do not know much of this place aside from it containing these crystals that supposedly have the very elements within them. If you find yourself there, please bring me a sample of each color.
95928.objectivesText: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.
95928.title: Crystalline Elements

95934.description:
My surveying tools show signs of a never-before-seen mineral in these caves. Cubic draconia, I call it. Probably worth a fortune.

Exciting as this is, no one's gonna come help me dig it up if I can't show 'em proof that it exists. Sure, I have the readings from my tools, but people like to hold a big shiny crystal, not look at charts.

I'm sure there's a few crystals poking up from the dirt in there. If you're willing to dodge a few dragons and get one, you'd really be helpin' a gal out.
95934.objectivesText: Find a piece of Cubic Draconia for Gelinda Coppergleam.
95934.title: Proof of Profit

95951.description:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.
95951.objectivesText: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.
95951.title: Fetch 'n' Fletch

95975.description:
Tess says little Emm can't sleep without me? And you did all that for them? A total stranger? Damn it. What was I thinking...

Even if I can't guarantee a perfect world for her, I still need to be a part of it. What am I even fighting for if I can't hope for a brighter future?

Thank you for helping my family in my absence, friend, but it's time for me to go home. If I could ask one more favor, can you pick some flowers and take them to Tess? Let her know I'll be home soon? I need to clean up first.
95975.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Wildflowers and deliver them to Tessa Dawnbright in Farholde Keep.
95975.title: Her World

95982.description:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.
95982.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
95982.title: Not My Circus

95983.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to the nearby watchman and see what he knows.
95983.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95983.title: A Feast for Buzzards

95984.description:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one's especially large. The leader of the nearby pride, most likely.

If rumor spreads about a man-eating lion prowling around on my watch, Demar will be furious. Fortunately, I have a plan.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. We can use that to lure the beast out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound. There's tallstriders all over the plains. Get me a beak, and make it snappy!
95984.objectivesText: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95984.title: Song of the Strider

95986.description:
The whistle's made, $n. 

Take it, and go to the top of the hill where the lions are. Should be just north of here.

Once you're there, blow the whistle, and our man-eater should appear. I'd tell you not to come back if you don't manage to kill him, but you'll probably be dead anyhow.

Now then, off with you. Let's see if you fare better than our skeletal friend.
