95986.objectivesText: Use the Tallstrider Call to call forth the leader of the lion pride. Slay the beast and retrieve its hide for Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch.
95986.title: King of the Wild Plains

95988.description:
Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out.

You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up.

Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.
95988.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Crawler Spittle, Fresh Chum, Goblin Degreaser, and Expired Poison for Innkeeper Zizplink in Powderfuse Port.
95988.title: Goes Down Smooth

95991.description:
It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean!

I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put!

-- Wheatley
95991.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Wheatley in Farholde Keep.
95991.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95992.description:
Dese waters be treacherous. My headhunters keep the paths clear as dey can, but there be a beasty stalkin' de rivers even we cannot catch. Excitin', eh?

Boss say we gotta clear it out, so we got a little competition goin'. Find de white one patrollin' de rivers and bring me its fang. Whoever sticks this slippery crocolisk win de whole pot. Just don't get snapped yourself, heheh!

-- Tan'jani
95992.objectivesText: Bring Ghostmaw's Fang to Tan'jani in Rog'mar.
95992.title: WANTED: Ghostmaw

95998.description:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.objectivesText: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
95998.title: The Great Outdoors

95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectivesText: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96003.description:
As suspected, the vessels fused into something new--something powerful.

I suppose if the vessels capture stored energy, there must be a way to use that power to our advantage. Fel artifacts are rarely safe or easy to come by, but we might as well do something with it, hmm?

Time for a field test.

Take the crystal and use it against Bethra'zel and Mazzogore--two of their most powerful demons. Their presence alone has ensured the camp is well protected. Let's see if we can change that.
96003.objectivesText: Use the Eye of Endless Influence on Bethra'zel and Mazzogore to siphon their power, then deliver the killing blow.
96003.title: Drawing Down the Malevolent

96015.description:
We should be thankful that our foe is stupid. An army of ogres at their disposal, and the Twilight's Hammer have them working in the mines nowhere near the fight. I don't know if I chalk it up to mismanagement or an internal struggle, but either way they're in no position to defend themselves.

That's where we come in. With the cult's focus divided, we have an opportunity to strike the enemy while they're vulnerable and split them further. Go to this mine and sow some chaos among their ranks.
96015.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Ogre Miners and $2oa Twilight Subjugators in the cave near the Twilight's Shroud for Sergeant Riftan.
96015.title: A Miner Problem

96020.description:
<The carving is faintly warm to the touch, despite the long-cold char on the body you retrieved it from.

It appears the poor soul didn't finish whatever they were trying to enact. Though you don't recognize the inscriptions on the idol, it calls to your fire magic. Perhaps you may succeed where they have failed.>
96020.objectivesText: Complete the Brimstone Carving's ritual and bring the results to a warlock trainer.
96020.title: Playing with Fire

96025.description:
Thank you for your help, $n. A dear friend of mine awaits your arrival at the summit.

You can find her up the road to the east.
96025.objectivesText: Meet Elaena's friend at the summit in Hyjal.
96025.title: As the Crow Flies

96026.description:
Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock.

Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks.

Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
96026.objectivesText: Deliver $1oa Heavy Weightstones to Hamur in Bolder'ok.
96026.title: Step Two: More Rock

96028.description:
Bal stupid. He only want hit things.

Mog smart. Mog learn magic to make Bal'mog stronger.

We show Bal he stupid. We use magic. Use magic to show Mog better!
96028.objectivesText: Use $1oa magic for Bal'mog in Bolder'ok.
96028.title: Magic Over Might

96031.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.objectivesText: Speak with Gretta Finespindle in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96044.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.objectivesText: Speak with Tognus Flintfire in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96044.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

96046.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046.objectivesText: Speak with Yarr Hammerstone in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96046.title: Camping 101: Mining

96047.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

96047.objectivesText: Speak with Thamner Pol in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96056.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056.objectivesText: Speak with Balthus Stoneflayer in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96056.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96057.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057.objectivesText: Speak with Uthrar Threx in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96057.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96058.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058.objectivesText: Speak with Bronk Guzzlegear in Kharanos to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96058.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96059.description:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059.objectivesText: Speak with Thonys Pillarstone in Ironforge to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96059.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96063.description:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
96063.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
96063.title: Gaseous Gold

96067.areaDescription: Fight G45-B4G in a stress test of Sleebo's engine.
96067.description:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
96067.title: Rock 'em and Sock 'em

96075.description:
My employers are looking to get their hands on legal documents surrounding the ownership of Blackrock Mountain. Some kind of property dispute. In any case, if you could acquire these key records, I can afford to reward you generously.

Retrieve Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in the upper part of Blackrock Spire, an Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in the lower part of Blackrock Spire, and a Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in the Blackrock Depths.
96075.objectivesText: Acquire Nefarian's Remit from General Drakkisath in Blackrock Spire, Overseer's License from Overlord Wyrmthalak in Blackrock Spire, and Bronzebeard Wedding Contract from Emperor Thaurissan in Blackrock Depths, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96075.title: In Demand - Blackrock Legal Records

96076.description:
My employers are looking to get their hands on magical curiosities from the ruined elven city of Eldre'Thalas, now known as Dire Maul. Some kind of magical research. In any case, if you could acquire these items, I can afford to reward you generously.

Retrieve a Felvine Seed from Alzzin the Wildshaper in the eastern wing, an Ancient Memento from Prince Tortheldrin in the western wing, and an Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring from King Gordok in the northern wing.
96076.objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul to acquire a Felvine Seed from Alzzin the Wildshaper, an Ancient Memento from Prince Tortheldrin, and an Earthstone Diamond Pinky Ring from King Gordok, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96076.title: In Demand - Ancient Elven Curiosities

conditionalDescriptions.text:
$n, you know our tribe keeps our traditions alive by oral storytelling and passing legends such as these to the next generation. No doubt you yourself have learned lessons and heard such cautionary tales in your youth.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. I am sure he would be happy to see you again, and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.

96078.description:
$n, we Darkspear keep much of our traditions alive by oral storytelling. We pass legends such as these to the next generation, teaching lessons and weaving cautionary tales to our younglings.

These etchings must be taken to our spiritual leader, Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. He is one of the wisest Darkspear and he will wish to hear the truth of this tale.

I have prepared an extra copy of this tale for you as well. If you ever lose your copy, I would be happy to create another, for a small fee.
96078.objectivesText: Take the tablet etchings to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
96078.title: A Tale Spun Around the Fire

96082.description:
I will fashion the cloth you've given me into bandages. In the meantime, please take these ones that I have already made, and dress the wounds of the soldiers who need it. It should be a matter of basic first aid.

Your assistance here is both necessary, and highly appreciated. I simply cannot be everywhere at once.
96082.objectivesText: Bandage up 3 Wounded Soldiers for Brother Lowley.
96082.title: Doctor's Orderly

96085.description:
The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic.

I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature.

Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.
96085.objectivesText: Find whatever creature is causing the drinking water contamination and eliminate it. Then, return to Sister Rowland at the chapel in Farholde Keep.
96085.title: Upstream Contamination

96087.description:
A group of historians contracted me to recover records of the great plague. Prove who's guilty and who's not or some such. Acquire a few of these records for me, and I'll reward you generously.

Retrieve the Headmaster's Records from Darkmaster Gandling in the Scholomance, Grain Shipment Orders from Baron Rivendare in the ever-burning city of Stratholme, and Dathrohan's Correspondence from Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan in the Scarlet Bastion of Stratholme.
96087.objectivesText: Acquire Headmaster's Records from Darkmaster Gandling, Grain Shipment Orders from Baron Rivendare, and Dathrohan's Correspondence from Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan, and bring them to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
96087.title: In Demand - Plague Records

96101.description:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101.objectivesText: Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96101.title: The Great Outdoors

96102.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102.objectivesText: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
96102.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96103.description:
The skeleton is badly mangled. Deep markings on its limbs vaguely match patterns of teeth and claws. Many days beneath the beating sun have made the bones pale and brittle as well. The brutality of both the attacker and the weather have rendered the victim's identity a mystery.

You can't take the whole skeleton with you, but you could bring its skull to a hunter at Rog'mar and see what they know.
96103.objectivesText: Bring the Gnawed Skull to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96103.title: A Feast for Buzzards

96107.description:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.

Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.

The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?
96107.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
96107.title: Feathers for Fletching

96125.description:
Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break.

At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing.

Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return.

Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
96125.objectivesText: Find Dunston Willis somewhere among the ogres in Bolder'ok.
96125.title: In Need of Relief

96126.description:
I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me.

As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep.

While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement.

I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. 

My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
96126.objectivesText: Find Gronok the Butcher, kill him, and bring Dunston the key to his shackles.
96126.title: An Ogre's Captive

96130.description:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.objectivesText: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.title: Chakuyak

96131.description:
I'm sure you've met that old stick-in-the-mud, that lives in the cave south of here? 

You must take this staff to him along with my feather. He will know what it means. Or he won't! Either way it will get his attention.

He may be an oldstone, but he is reliable. He's one of the few mortals I would trust with a matter as grave as this. 
 
Quickly, Dirtwalker! I fear a shadow is falling over Hyjal we cannot see.
96131.objectivesText: Take the Faintly Glowing Branch to Ketharas.
96131.title: An Oldstone But An Old Friend

96145.description:
Traveler, be wary! Though the Shrine of Aviana lies ahead, the area is claimed now by the harpies of the Wormwing tribe.

Like my family, the Highfeathers, I am a follower of Aviana, but the Wormwings are not so loyal. They are a danger to anyone who passes through their territory.

If you can make your way past them, my cousin Phoebe Highfeather helps to protect the shrine.
96145.objectivesText: Seek Phoebe Highfeather at the Shrine of Aviana.
96145.title: Past Wing and Claw

96209.description:
The ancient, Orokai, stands vigil just outside of town. Take this to him. The ancients are wondrous and wise. Provided this branch has not been separated from its parent tree for too long, he will be able to "speak" with it to learn what tales it has to tell.

You can find Orokai to the southwest of the town, not too far away.
96209.title: The Ancient, Orokai

96252.description:
$C, I would ask a favor of you. One that is deeply personal.

When they ambushed and killed my sisters, the Wormwings took their jewelry claiming these treasures as trophies of battle. What's worse, they've stashed our treasures in their nests with their unborn young; further proof of their depravity.

Please collect my fallen sisters' treasures. Avoid harming the unhatched eggs if you can, but I'll lose no sleep over the broken eggs of our enemies.
96252.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Tarnished Highfeather Bangles from Wormwing Harpy nests.
96252.title: Tarnished Treasures

96259.description:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Gloomrise Hatchlings and $2oa Gloomrise Soldiers.
96259.title: Defending the Dead

96260.description:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.objectivesText: Gather $1oa strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.
96260.title: Stronger than Steel

96294.description:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294.objectivesText: Bring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.
96294.title: A Darker Truth

96301.description:
With the venomous, poisonous heart of the chimaera Ghansurok in hand, soak in the ancient waters of the Well of Eternity.

Watch closely how the waters react to the corruption, how nature remembers what systemic corruption has tried to unmake.

Bring the organ back to me, and together we will read the signs it bears, and learn whether balance can yet be restored... or if the wound runs too deep.

objectives.text: Well of Eternity entered with the chimaera heart

96301.objectivesText: Enter the Well of Eternity and observe its effects on the Venom-dripping Heart.
96301.title: Power Wash

96332.description:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.
96332.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.
96332.title: A Little Payback

96334.description:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.
96334.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect $1oa Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.
96334.title: Blood Red Bandanas

96339.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96381.description:
Was spyin' on the shore of Alcaz with my trusty lookin' glass whilst you were off eavesdroppin' on Lady Proudmoore. I think the island may be under attack. I saw naga--lots of them, chargin' onto shore. 

The enemy of my enemy is certainly not my friend when it comes to naga, so let's do the world a favor and take some of them out. I also spied what looks to be the leader--a spellcaster type barkin' orders. Take her out as well, if you can.
96381.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa  Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sully McCleary.
96381.title: A Bit of Wet Work

96390.description:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

conditionalDescriptions.text:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".

96391.description:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
96391.objectivesText: Deliver the Dark Iron Map to Earthseer Farsen in Dun Morogh.
96391.title: Underground Map

96392.description:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392.objectivesText: Speak with Earthseer Farsen and ask him to lend you his far sight to observe the Dark Iron threat.
96392.title: Farsen's Watch

96394.description:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Enraged Apparitions, $2oa Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
96394.title: The Restless Dead

96395.description:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395.objectivesText: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar to rest and then return to the Ghostly Attendant in the Hall of Thanes.
96395.title: An Ancient Grudge

96435.description:
<Felflick cackles gleefully as he regards the bloody bones of the Ashen Reign leaders.>

Oh this is just perfect!

<Felflick hops back and forth in his cage, snickering all the while.>

Now it is time to give those warlocks the fate they deserve. There is a massive bone pile to the west of here if you follow the road. Trust me, it's impossible to miss. That's where all their 'failed' experiments go.

That is where I wish to dump these fools' remains. Let the whole world know what failures they are!

objectives.text: Warlock Bones Thrown on Slime Altar

96435.objectivesText: Throw the warlock bones onto the bone pile near the slime pools.
96435.title: A Fitting End

96494.description:
With the perimeter scouted, you've proven useful and trustworthy enough to bring into the fold.

I'm here representing SI:7's efforts to gain crucial information important to the Alliance. Not just anyone is privy to this knowledge. Mind your discretion.

A druidic cult known as the Blackthorne Pact has taken root nearby, operating in service to something they call the Wild King.

Find the domain of this "Wild King" and mark it. Then we can report back to Stormwind with certainty.

objectives.text: Find the entrance to Hyjal Summit

96494.objectivesText: Find the Blackthorne reinforcement point at the entrance to Hyjal Summit.
96494.title: Gathering Storm

96529.description:
Your help has been key to our scouting efforts. Take this information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

Remember, you're not to speak of our activities here, my presence, or SI:7 involvement to anyone else. I have a lot to continue setting up here, and plans to keep on track. 

We'll be in touch.
96529.objectivesText: Bring the Blackthorne Information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
96529.title: A Shaw Deal

96550.description:
The aged scabbard is embellished with carved designs and markings. This matches the description spoken by the war veteran. A dramatic view of the land below is a breathtaking sight.

Perhaps simply holding the scabbard in your hand while remembering the veteran's words will beckon the spirit to this memory.
96550.objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to speak with the war veteran and hear his story at the overlook in Elderwild.
96550.title: Battle Recall

96558.description:
Beneath the shattered stones of that watchtower lies a cache we buried in haste, when the world was starting to burn. What little we carried from Hyjal rests there still. Take it--you have earned that much.

The pull is increasing... the mountain no longer holds me as it once did. I am unsure if we will ever speak again.

Because of you, I remember who I was, and who we were. Go with my thanks, and let this spirit finally be at peace.
96558.objectivesText: Recover the Battle Cache buried on Mount Hyjal.
96558.title: Soldier's Solace

96603.description:
Archmage Rhonin is presently abroad investigating a disturbance in the flow of magic across Azeroth. The Archmage has charged me with soliciting the aid of strong adventurers like yourself in gathering important field data to aid him.

Take this Arcane Censer. While afflicted by its magic, you will be able to extract motes of unstable magic from the most skilled spell casters and other singularly powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me said motes and the Kirin Tor will be in your debt.
96603.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.
96603.title: Unstable Magic

96604.description:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604.objectivesText: Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96604.title: The Great Outdoors

96605.description:

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.

96605.title: The Great Outdoors

96608.title: The Great Outdoors

96609.description:
Are you familiar with Silvermoon Shimmerwine? It has a delicate flavor that is entirely unique to the vineyards of Eversong and it is the one thing I truly miss from my homeland.

Unfortunately, it is extremely hard to find on this side of the Thalassian Gate.

I had a patron bring me a bottle that he claimed to have "liberated" from blood elves in northern Azshara. If your adventures take you to that region and you can recover more bottles for me, I would handsomely reward your efforts.
96609.objectivesText: Bring $1oa bottles of Silvermoon Shimmerwine to Arille Azuregaze in Dalaran city.
96609.title: A Taste of Home

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ortak looks alarmed as you approach but calms as it becomes clear you aren't Scourge.>

You...you are not Scourge? But you are undead? How is this possible...?

Well, stranger, if you are offering to aid us here I will not turn you away. We have been trapped here since the end of the war. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

I would ask a favor of you, if you are willing. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.

96616.description:
Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal!

I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

Please, $c. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.
96616.title: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary

96626.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Tomas in Goldshire

96626.objectivesText: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.
96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627.description:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.objectivesText: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.
96627.title: The Adventurer

96628.description:
Wait, $n. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.objectivesText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer near Kharanos.
96628.title: The Adventurer

96629.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos

96629.objectivesText: Speak with Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos to learn to become a cook.
96629.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96630.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Lyreena Duskblade near Dolanaar.
96630.title: The Adventurer

96634.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zarrin in Dolanaar

96634.objectivesText: Speak with Zarrin in Dolanaar to learn to become a cook.
96634.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96638.description:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638.objectivesText: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
96638.title: The Adventurer

96646.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village

96646.objectivesText: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.
96646.title: Camping 101: Cooking

<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652.objectivesText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
96652.title: The Adventurer
